```html
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </template>
    
    <!-- Alert container for displaying messages -->
    <div id="alert" class="alert hidden"></div>
    
    <script type="module">
      // This script populates the events from the server data
      document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
        // The server will inject this data when rendering the page
        const events = window.eventsData || [];
        
        const eventContainer = document.getElementById('event-container');
        const noEventsMessage = document.getElementById('no-events-message');
        const template = document.getElementById('event-card-template');
        const searchInput = document.getElementById('eventSearch');
        const searchButton = document.getElementById('searchButton');
        const filterUpcoming = document.getElementById('filterUpcoming');
        const filterAvailable = document.getElementById('filterAvailable');
        
        // Show/hide appropriate elements based on events
        if (events.length === 0) {
          noEventsMessage.classList.remove('hidden');
          return;
        }
        
        // Render all events initially
        renderEvents(events);
        
        // Set up search and filters
        searchButton.addEventListener('click', filterEvents);
        searchInput.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
          if (e.key === 'Enter') filterEvents();
        });
        filterUpcoming.addEventListener('change', filterEvents);
        filterAvailable.addEventListener('change', filterEvents);
        
        function filterEvents() {
          const searchTerm = searchInput.value.toLowerCase();
          const showUpcoming = filterUpcoming.checked;
          const showOnlyAvailable = filterAvailable.checked;
          
          const now = new Date();
          
          const filteredEvents = events.filter(event => {
            // Search term filter
            const eventDate = new Date(event.eventDate);
            const options = {weekday: "short", year: "numeric", month: "short", day: "numeric"};
            const dateString = eventDate.toLocaleDateString(undefined, options);
            const textToSearch = `${event.eventName} ${event.eventLocation} ${dateString}`.toLowerCase();
            const matchesSearch = !searchTerm || textToSearch.includes(searchTerm);
            
            // Upcoming filter
            const isUpcoming = !showUpcoming || eventDate >= now;
            
            // Available spots filter
            const hasSpots = !showOnlyAvailable || event.eventBookings.length < event.scheduleConfiguration.players;
            
            return matchesSearch && isUpcoming && hasSpots;
          });
          
          // Clear and render filtered events
          eventContainer.innerHTML = '';
          if (filteredEvents.length === 0) {
            noEventsMessage.classList.remove('hidden');
          } else {
            noEventsMessage.classList.add('hidden');
            renderEvents(filteredEvents);
          }
        }
        
        function renderEvents(eventsToRender) {
          eventsToRender.forEach(event => {
            const clone = document.importNode(template.content, true);
            
            // Format the date
            const options = {weekday: "short", year: "numeric", month: "short", day: "numeric"};
            const eventDate = new Date(event.eventDate).toLocaleDateString(undefined, options);
            
            // Set event details
            clone.querySelector('.event-date-text').textContent = eventDate;
            clone.querySelector('.event-time-text').textContent = event.eventStartTime;
            clone.querySelector('.event-location-text').textContent = event.eventLocation;
            clone.querySelector('.event-id').textContent = event._id;
            
            // Add players
            const playersList = clone.querySelector('.player-list');
            const waitList = clone.querySelector('.waitlist-list');
            const playersLimit = event.scheduleConfiguration.players;
            
            event.eventBookings.forEach((booking, index) => {
              const listItem = document.createElement(index < playersLimit ? 'li' : 'li');
              listItem.textContent = booking.userName;
              
              if (index < playersLimit) {
                playersList.appendChild(listItem);
              } else {
                if (index === playersLimit) {
                  // Show waitlist section when we hit the first waitlisted player
                  clone.querySelector('.event-waitlist').classList.remove('hidden');
                }
                waitList.appendChild(listItem);
              }
            });
            
            // Update status badge
            const isWaitList = event.eventBookings.length >= playersLimit;
            const statusText = clone.querySelector('.status-text');
            const statusBadge = clone.querySelector('.status-badge');
            const bookBtnText = clone.querySelector('.book-btn-text');
            
            if (isWaitList) {
              statusText.textContent = 'Wait list only';
              statusBadge.classList.remove('available');
              statusBadge.classList.add('waitlist');
              bookBtnText.textContent = 'Join Wait List';
            } else {
              const spotsLeft = playersLimit - event.eventBookings.length;
              statusText.textContent = `${spotsLeft} spot${spotsLeft !== 1 ? 's' : ''} available`;
              bookBtnText.textContent = 'Book Event';
            }
            
            eventContainer.appendChild(clone);
          });
          
          // Add event listeners
          document.querySelectorAll('.book-event-btn').forEach(btn => {
            btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
              const eventId = this.closest('.event-card').querySelector('.event-id').textContent;
              // This will be handled by buttonDelegates.js
              // Just mocking it here for the template
              console.log(`Book event: ${eventId}`);
            });
          });
        }
      });
    </script>
  </body>
</html>
```

```html
    <script>
      document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        const createEventForm = document.getElementById('createEventForm');
        
        createEventForm.addEventListener('submit', async function(e) {
          e.preventDefault();
          
          const formData = new FormData(createEventForm);
          const eventData = {};
          
          // Convert FormData to object
          for (const [key, value] of formData.entries()) {
            if (key === 'active' || key === 'doublesToggle') {
              eventData[key] = true; // Checkbox is checked
            } else if (key === 'selectedScheduleConfig' && value) {
              eventData[key] = JSON.parse(value);
            } else {
              eventData[key] = value;
            }
          }
          
          // Handle unchecked checkboxes
          if (!formData.has('active')) {
            eventData.active = false;
          }
          
          if (!formData.has('doublesToggle')) {
            eventData.doublesToggle = false;
          }
          
          try {
            const response = await fetch('/api/v1/events', {
              method: 'POST',
              headers: {
                'Content-Type': 'application/json'
              },
              body: JSON.stringify(eventData)
            });
            
            const data = await response.json();
            
            if (response.ok) {
              // Show success message and redirect
              alert('Event created successfully!');
              window.location.href = `/events/showAll`;
            } else {
              // Show error message
              alert(`Error: ${data.message || 'Failed to create event'}`);
            }
          } catch (err) {
            console.error('Error creating event:', err);
            alert('An error occurred while creating the event');
          }
        });
```

```html
                </div>
                
                <div class="form-row">
                  <div class="form-group col-md-6">
                    <label for="startTime">Start Time</label>
                    <input type="time" id="startTime" name="startTime" class="form-control" required>
                  </div>
                  
                  <div class="form-group col-md-6">
                    <label for="endTime">End Time</label>
                    <input type="time" id="endTime" name="endTime" class="form-control" required>
                  </div>
                </div>
                
                <div class="form-group">
                  <label for="location">Location</label>
                  <input type="text" id="location" name="location" class="form-control" required>
                </div>
                
                <div class="form-group">
                  <label for="description">Description</label>
                  <textarea id="description" name="description" class="form-control" rows="4"></textarea>
                </div>
                
                <div class="form-row">
                  <div class="form-group col-md-6">
                    <label for="maxPlayers">Maximum Players</label>
                    <input type="number" id="maxPlayers" name="maxPlayers" class="form-control" min="1" required>
                  </div>
                  
                  <div class="form-group col-md-6">
                    <label for="skillLevel">Skill Level</label>
                    <select id="skillLevel" name="skillLevel" class="form-control">
                      <option value="beginner">Beginner</option>
                      <option value="intermediate">Intermediate</option>
                      <option value="advanced">Advanced</option>
                      <option value="all">All Levels</option>
                    </select>
                  </div>
                </div>
                
                <div class="form-row">
                  <div class="form-group col-md-6">
                    <label for="price">Price ($)</label>
                    <input type="number" id="price" name="price" class="form-control" min="0" step="0.01">
                  </div>
                  
                  <div class="form-group col-md-6">
                    <label for="status">Status</label>
                    <select id="status" name="status" class="form-control">
                      <option value="draft">Draft</option>
                      <option value="published">Published</option>
                      <option value="cancelled">Cancelled</option>
                    </select>
                  </div>
                </div>
                
                <div class="form-group">
                  <div class="checkbox-group">
                    <input type="checkbox" id="registrationOpen" name="registrationOpen" class="checkbox-input">
                    <label for="registrationOpen" class="checkbox-label">Registration Open</label>
                  </div>
                </div>
                
                <h3 class="section-title mt-4">Event Schedule</h3>
                
                <div id="sessionsContainer">
                  <!-- Sessions will be added here -->
                </div>
                
                <div class="form-actions mt-2 mb-4">
                  <button type="button" id="addSessionButton" class="btn btn-outline">
                    <i class="fas fa-plus"></i> Add Session
                  </button>
                </div>
                
                <div class="form-actions">
                  <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary">Save Changes</button>
                  <a href="/events/myBrowse" class="btn btn-outline">Cancel</a>
                  <button type="button" id="deleteEventButton" class="btn btn-danger ml-auto">Delete Event</button>
                </div>
              </form>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>
    </main>
    
    <!-- Confirmation Modal -->
    <div id="confirmationModal" class="modal">
      <div class="modal-content">
        <div class="modal-header">
          <h3>Confirm Deletion</h3>
          <button class="modal-close">&times;</button>
        </div>
        <div class="modal-body">
          <p>Are you sure you want to delete this event? This action cannot be undone.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="modal-footer">
          <button id="confirmDeleteButton" class="btn btn-danger">Delete</button>
          <button id="cancelDeleteButton" class="btn btn-outline">Cancel</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
    
    <script>
      document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        const editEventForm = document.getElementById('editEventForm');
        const addSessionButton = document.getElementById('addSessionButton');
        const sessionsContainer = document.getElementById('sessionsContainer');
        const deleteEventButton = document.getElementById('deleteEventButton');
        const confirmationModal = document.getElementById('confirmationModal');
        const confirmDeleteButton = document.getElementById('confirmDeleteButton');
        const cancelDeleteButton = document.getElementById('cancelDeleteButton');
        const modalClose = document.querySelector('.modal-close');
        
        // Get the event ID from the URL
        const eventId = window.location.pathname.split('/').pop();
        let sessions = [];
        
        // Fetch event data
        fetch(`/api/v1/events/${eventId}`)
          .then(response => response.json())
          .then(data => {
            if (data.status === 'success' && data.data && data.data.event) {
              const event = data.data.event;
              
              // Populate form fields
              document.getElementById('name').value = event.name || '';
              document.getElementById('eventType').value = event.eventType || 'social';
              document.getElementById('location').value = event.location || '';
              document.getElementById('description').value = event.description || '';
              document.getElementById('maxPlayers').value = event.maxPlayers || '';
              document.getElementById('skillLevel').value = event.skillLevel || 'all';
              document.getElementById('price').value = event.price || '0';
              document.getElementById('status').value = event.status || 'published';
              document.getElementById('registrationOpen').checked = event.registrationOpen;
              
              // Format dates and times
              if (event.startDate) {
                const startDate = new Date(event.startDate);
                document.getElementById('startDate').value = startDate.toISOString().split('T')[0];
                
                if (event.startTime) {
                  document.getElementById('startTime').value = event.startTime;
                } else {
                  document.getElementById('startTime').value = '09:00';
                }
              }
              
              if (event.endDate) {
                const endDate = new Date(event.endDate);
                document.getElementById('endDate').value = endDate.toISOString().split('T')[0];
                
                if (event.endTime) {
                  document.getElementById('endTime').value = event.endTime;
                } else {
                  document.getElementById('endTime').value = '17:00';
                }
              }
              
              // Load sessions
              if (event.sessions && event.sessions.length > 0) {
                sessions = event.sessions;
                renderSessions();
              }
            } else {
              alert('Failed to load event data');
            }
          })
          .catch(err => {
            console.error('Error fetching event data:', err);
            alert('An error occurred while loading event data');
          });
        
        // Add session
        addSessionButton.addEventListener('click', function() {
          const newSession = {
            id: Date.now(), // Unique ID for client-side tracking
            name: `Session ${sessions.length + 1}`,
            startTime: '09:00',
            endTime: '10:00',
            maxPlayers: 16,
            courts: 4
          };
          
          sessions.push(newSession);
          renderSessions();
        });
        
        // Render sessions
        function renderSessions() {
          sessionsContainer.innerHTML = '';
          
          sessions.forEach((session, index) => {
            const sessionDiv = document.createElement('div');
            sessionDiv.className = 'session-card';
            sessionDiv.dataset.sessionId = session.id;
            
            sessionDiv.innerHTML = `
              <div class="session-header">
                <h4>Session ${index + 1}</h4>
                <button type="button" class="btn-icon remove-session" data-session-id="${session.id}">
                  <i class="fas fa-times"></i>
                </button>
              </div>
              
              <div class="form-row">
                <div class="form-group col-md-6">
                  <label for="sessionName-${session.id}">Session Name</label>
                  <input type="text" id="sessionName-${session.id}" name="sessionName-${session.id}" 
                    class="form-control" value="${session.name || ''}">
                </div>
                
                <div class="form-group col-md-3">
                  <label for="sessionStart-${session.id}">Start Time</label>
                  <input type="time" id="sessionStart-${session.id}" name="sessionStart-${session.id}" 
                    class="form-control" value="${session.startTime || '09:00'}">
                </div>
                
                <div class="form-group col-md-3">
                  <label for="sessionEnd-${session.id}">End Time</label>
                  <input type="time" id="sessionEnd-${session.id}" name="sessionEnd-${session.id}" 
                    class="form-control" value="${session.endTime || '10:00'}">
                </div>
              </div>
              
              <div class="form-row">
                <div class="form-group col-md-6">
                  <label for="sessionMaxPlayers-${session.id}">Max Players</label>
                  <input type="number" id="sessionMaxPlayers-${session.id}" name="sessionMaxPlayers-${session.id}" 
                    class="form-control" min="1" value="${session.maxPlayers || 16}">
                </div>
                
                <div class="form-group col-md-6">
                  <label for="sessionCourts-${session.id}">Number of Courts</label>
                  <input type="number" id="sessionCourts-${session.id}" name="sessionCourts-${session.id}" 
                    class="form-control" min="1" value="${session.courts || 4}">
                </div>
              </div>
            `;
            
            sessionsContainer.appendChild(sessionDiv);
          });
          
          // Add event listeners for remove session buttons
          document.querySelectorAll('.remove-session').forEach(button => {
            button.addEventListener('click', function() {
              const sessionId = parseInt(this.dataset.sessionId);
              sessions = sessions.filter(session => session.id !== sessionId);
              renderSessions();
            });
          });
        }
        
        // Handle form submission
        editEventForm.addEventListener('submit', async function(e) {
          e.preventDefault();
          
          // Gather form data
          const formData = new FormData(editEventForm);
          const eventData = {};
          
          // Convert FormData to object (for basic fields)
          for (const [key, value] of formData.entries()) {
            if (!key.startsWith('session')) { // Skip session fields
              if (key === 'registrationOpen') {
                eventData[key] = true; // Checkbox is checked
              } else {
                eventData[key] = value;
              }
            }
          }
          
          // Handle unchecked checkboxes
          if (!formData.has('registrationOpen')) {
            eventData.registrationOpen = false;
          }
          
          // Update sessions data from form
          const updatedSessions = sessions.map(session => {
            const sessionId = session.id;
            return {
              id: session.id,
              name: document.getElementById(`sessionName-${sessionId}`).value,
              startTime: document.getElementById(`sessionStart-${sessionId}`).value,
              endTime: document.getElementById(`sessionEnd-${sessionId}`).value,
              maxPlayers: parseInt(document.getElementById(`sessionMaxPlayers-${sessionId}`).value),
              courts: parseInt(document.getElementById(`sessionCourts-${sessionId}`).value)
            };
          });
          
          eventData.sessions = updatedSessions;
          
          try {
            const response = await fetch(`/api/v1/events/${eventId}`, {
              method: 'PATCH',
              headers: {
                'Content-Type': 'application/json'
              },
              body: JSON.stringify(eventData)
            });
            
            const data = await response.json();
            
            if (response.ok) {
              // Show success message
              alert('Event updated successfully!');
              
              // Redirect to event browse page
              window.location.href = '/events/myBrowse';
            } else {
              // Show error message
              alert(`Error: ${data.message || 'Failed to update event'}`);
            }
          } catch (err) {
            console.error('Error updating event:', err);
            alert('An error occurred while updating the event');
          }
        });
        
        // Delete event
        deleteEventButton.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
          e.preventDefault();
          confirmationModal.style.display = 'flex';
        });
        
        // Confirmation modal
        confirmDeleteButton.addEventListener('click', async function() {
          try {
            const response = await fetch(`/api/v1/events/${eventId}`, {
              method: 'DELETE'
            });
            
            if (response.ok) {
              // Show success message
              alert('Event deleted successfully!');
              
              // Redirect to event browse page
              window.location.href = '/events/myBrowse';
            } else {
              const data = await response.json();
              // Show error message
              alert(`Error: ${data.message || 'Failed to delete event'}`);
            }
          } catch (err) {
            console.error('Error deleting event:', err);
            alert('An error occurred while deleting the event');
          } finally {
            confirmationModal.style.display = 'none';
          }
        });
        
        // Cancel delete
        cancelDeleteButton.addEventListener('click', function() {
          confirmationModal.style.display = 'none';
        });
        
        // Close modal when clicking the X
        modalClose.addEventListener('click', function() {
          confirmationModal.style.display = 'none';
        });
        
        // Close modal when clicking outside
        window.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
          if (e.target === confirmationModal) {
            confirmationModal.style.display = 'none';
          }
        });
      });
    </script>
  </body>
</html>
```

```html
                    </div>

                  <div class="form-group">

                    <input type="text" id="notificationPrefix" name="notificationPrefix" class="form-control">
                    <small class="form-help-text">This text will appear at the beginning of all notifications.</small>
                  </div>
                </div>
                
                <div class="form-section">
                  <h3 class="section-title">Scheduling Settings</h3>
                  
                  <div class="form-group">
                    <label for="defaultSessionDuration">Default Session Duration (minutes)</label>
                    <input type="number" id="defaultSessionDuration" name="defaultSessionDuration" class="form-control" min="5" step="5">
                  </div>

                    <input type="number" id="maxSessionsPerEvent" name="maxSessionsPerEvent" class="form-control" min="1">
                  </div>

                <div class="form-section">
                  <h3 class="section-title">Security Settings</h3>
                  
                  <div class="form-group">
                    <label for="maxLoginAttempts">Maximum Login Attempts</label>
                    <input type="number" id="maxLoginAttempts" name="maxLoginAttempts" class="form-control" min="1">
                  </div>
                  
                  <div class="form-group">
                    <label for="passwordResetTimeLimit">Password Reset Time Limit (minutes)</label>
                    <input type="number" id="passwordResetTimeLimit" name="passwordResetTimeLimit" class="form-control" min="5">
                  </div>
                  
                  <div class="form-group">
                    <label for="sessionTimeout">Session Timeout (minutes)</label>
                    <input type="number" id="sessionTimeout" name="sessionTimeout" class="form-control" min="5">
                  </div>
                </div>
                
                <div class="form-actions">
                  <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary">Save Settings</button>
                  <button type="button" id="resetToDefaultsButton" class="btn btn-danger">Reset to Defaults</button>
                </div>
              </form>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>
    </main>
    
    <script>
      document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        const systemSettingsForm = document.getElementById('systemSettingsForm');
        const resetToDefaultsButton = document.getElementById('resetToDefaultsButton');
        
        // Fetch current settings
        fetch('/api/v1/settings')
          .then(response => response.json())
          .then(data => {
            if (data.status === 'success' && data.data && data.data.settings) {
              const settings = data.data.settings;
              
              // Populate form fields with current settings
              for (const key in settings) {
                const element = document.getElementById(key);
                if (element) {
                  if (element.type === 'checkbox') {
                    element.checked = settings[key];
                  } else {
                    element.value = settings[key];
                  }
                }
              }
            } else {
              alert('Failed to load system settings');
            }
          })
          .catch(err => {
            console.error('Error fetching system settings:', err);
            alert('An error occurred while loading system settings');
          });
        
        // Handle form submission
        systemSettingsForm.addEventListener('submit', async function(e) {
          e.preventDefault();
          
          const formData = new FormData(systemSettingsForm);
          const settingsData = {};
          
          // Convert FormData to object
          for (const [key, value] of formData.entries()) {
            if (document.getElementById(key).type === 'checkbox') {
              settingsData[key] = true; // Checkbox is checked
            } else if (document.getElementById(key).type === 'number') {
              settingsData[key] = parseInt(value, 10);
            } else {
              settingsData[key] = value;
            }
          }
          
          // Handle unchecked checkboxes
          const checkboxes = systemSettingsForm.querySelectorAll('input[type="checkbox"]');
          checkboxes.forEach(checkbox => {
            if (!formData.has(checkbox.name)) {
              settingsData[checkbox.name] = false;
            }
          });
          
          try {
            const response = await fetch('/api/v1/settings', {
              method: 'PATCH',
              headers: {
                'Content-Type': 'application/json'
              },
              body: JSON.stringify(settingsData)
            });
            
            const data = await response.json();
            
            if (response.ok) {
              // Show success message
              alert('System settings updated successfully!');
            } else {
              // Show error message
              alert(`Error: ${data.message || 'Failed to update system settings'}`);
            }
          } catch (err) {
            console.error('Error updating system settings:', err);
            alert('An error occurred while updating system settings');
          }
        });
        
        // Handle reset to defaults
        resetToDefaultsButton.addEventListener('click', async function() {
          if (confirm('Are you sure you want to reset all settings to default values? This cannot be undone.')) {
            try {
              const response = await fetch('/api/v1/settings/reset', {
                method: 'POST'
              });
              
              const data = await response.json();
              
              if (response.ok) {
                // Show success message
                alert('System settings reset to defaults');
                
                // Reload the page to show the default settings
                window.location.reload();
              } else {
                // Show error message
                alert(`Error: ${data.message || 'Failed to reset system settings'}`);
              }
            } catch (err) {
              console.error('Error resetting system settings:', err);
              alert('An error occurred while resetting system settings');
            }
          }
        });
      });
    </script>
  </body>
</html>
```

```html
    <script>
      document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        const editUserForm = document.getElementById('editUserForm');
        const userId = window.location.pathname.split('/').pop();
        
        // Fetch user data
        fetch(`/api/v1/users/${userId}`)
          .then(response => response.json())
          .then(data => {
            if (data.status === 'success' && data.data && data.data.user) {
              const user = data.data.user;
              
              // Populate form fields
              document.getElementById('name').value = user.name || '';
              document.getElementById('email').value = user.email || '';
              document.getElementById('mobile').value = user.mobile || '';
              document.getElementById('userId').value = user._id;
              document.getElementById('active').checked = user.active;
              
              // Set role
              const roleSelect = document.getElementById('role');
              for (let i = 0; i < roleSelect.options.length; i++) {
                if (roleSelect.options[i].value === user.role) {
                  roleSelect.selectedIndex = i;
                  break;
                }
              }
            } else {
              alert('Failed to load user data');
            }
          })
          .catch(err => {
            console.error('Error fetching user data:', err);
            alert('An error occurred while loading user data');
          });
        
        // Handle form submission
        editUserForm.addEventListener('submit', async function(e) {
          e.preventDefault();
          
          const formData = new FormData(editUserForm);
          const userData = {};
          
          // Convert FormData to object
          for (const [key, value] of formData.entries()) {
            if (key === 'active') {
              userData[key] = true; // Checkbox is checked
            } else if (key !== 'userId') { // Skip userId, we'll use it in the URL
              userData[key] = value;
            }
          }
          
          // Handle unchecked checkboxes
          if (!formData.has('active')) {
            userData.active = false;
          }
          
          try {
            const response = await fetch(`/api/v1/users/${formData.get('userId')}`, {
              method: 'PATCH',
              headers: {
                'Content-Type': 'application/json'
              },
              body: JSON.stringify(userData)
            });
            
            const data = await response.json();
            
            if (response.ok) {
              // Show success message and redirect
              alert('User updated successfully!');
              window.location.href = `/users/showAll`;
            } else {
              // Show error message
              alert(`Error: ${data.message || 'Failed to update user'}`);
            }
          } catch (err) {
            console.error('Error updating user:', err);
            alert('An error occurred while updating the user');
          }
        });
      });
    </script>
  </body>
</html>
```

```html
            <div class="error-icon">
              <i class="fas fa-exclamation-triangle"></i>
            </div>

            <p id="errorMessage" class="error-message">
              We're sorry, but there was an error processing your request.
            </p>
            
            <div class="error-actions">
              <a href="/" class="btn btn-primary">Go to Homepage</a>
              <button id="goBackButton" class="btn btn-outline">Go Back</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

    <script>
      document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        const errorTitle = document.getElementById('errorTitle');
        const errorMessage = document.getElementById('errorMessage');
        const goBackButton = document.getElementById('goBackButton');
        
        // Extract error information from URL params
        const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
        const statusCode = urlParams.get('statusCode');
        const message = urlParams.get('message');
        
        // Update error title based on status code
        if (statusCode) {
          if (statusCode === '404') {
            errorTitle.textContent = 'Page Not Found';
          } else if (statusCode === '403') {
            errorTitle.textContent = 'Access Forbidden';
          } else if (statusCode === '500') {
            errorTitle.textContent = 'Server Error';
          } else {
            errorTitle.textContent = `Error ${statusCode}`;
          }
        }
        
        // Update error message if provided
        if (message) {
          errorMessage.textContent = message;
        }
        
        // Set up go back button
        goBackButton.addEventListener('click', function() {
          window.history.back();
        });
      });
    </script>
  </body>
</html>
```

```html
      <section class="section">
        <div class="container">
          <div class="error-container">
            <div class="error-icon">
              <i class="fas fa-calendar-times"></i>
            </div>

            </p>
            
            <div class="error-actions">

            </div>

    <script>
      document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        // Handle logout button
        document.getElementById('logoutButton').addEventListener('click', async function(e) {
          e.preventDefault();
          
          try {
            const response = await fetch('/api/v1/users/logout', {
              method: 'GET'
            });
            
            if (response.ok) {
              // Redirect to login page
              window.location.href = '/login';
            } else {
              alert('Failed to logout. Please try again.');
            }
          } catch (err) {
            console.error('Error logging out:', err);
            alert('An error occurred while trying to logout');
          }
        });
      });
    </script>
  </body>
</html>
```

```html
                <div class="form-group">
                  <div class="checkbox-group">
                    <input type="checkbox" id="allowPlayerRests" name="allowPlayerRests" class="checkbox-input" checked>
                    <label for="allowPlayerRests" class="checkbox-label">Allow player rest periods</label>
                  </div>
                </div>
                
                <div class="form-actions">
                  <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary">Generate Schedule</button>
                  <button type="button" id="resetFormButton" class="btn btn-outline">Reset</button>
                </div>
              </form>
              
              <div id="scheduleSummary" class="schedule-summary mt-4" style="display: none;">
                <h3>Schedule Summary</h3>
                <div class="summary-stats">
                  <div class="stat-item">
                    <span class="stat-label">Total Playing Time:</span>
                    <span id="totalPlayingTime" class="stat-value">0 minutes</span>
                  </div>
                  <div class="stat-item">
                    <span class="stat-label">Average Games Per Player:</span>
                    <span id="avgGamesPerPlayer" class="stat-value">0</span>
                  </div>
                  <div class="stat-item">
                    <span class="stat-label">Total Sessions:</span>
                    <span id="totalSessions" class="stat-value">0</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
              
              <div id="scheduleContainer" class="schedule-container mt-4" style="display: none;">
                <h3>Generated Schedule</h3>
                <div class="tabs">
                  <div class="tab-header">
                    <button class="tab-button active" data-tab="roundView">Round View</button>
                    <button class="tab-button" data-tab="playerView">Player View</button>
                    <button class="tab-button" data-tab="courtView">Court View</button>
                  </div>
                  
                  <div class="tab-content">
                    <div id="roundView" class="tab-pane active">
                      <div id="roundSchedule" class="round-schedule"></div>
                    </div>
                    
                    <div id="playerView" class="tab-pane">
                      <div id="playerSchedule" class="player-schedule"></div>
                    </div>
                    
                    <div id="courtView" class="tab-pane">
                      <div id="courtSchedule" class="court-schedule"></div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
                
                <div class="schedule-actions mt-4">
                  <button id="saveScheduleButton" class="btn btn-primary">
                    <i class="fas fa-save"></i> Save Schedule
                  </button>
                  <button id="printScheduleButton" class="btn btn-outline">
                    <i class="fas fa-print"></i> Print Schedule
                  </button>
                  <button id="exportScheduleButton" class="btn btn-outline">
                    <i class="fas fa-file-export"></i> Export as CSV
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>
    </main>
    
    <script>
      document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        const scheduleCalculatorForm = document.getElementById('scheduleCalculatorForm');
        const resetFormButton = document.getElementById('resetFormButton');
        const scheduleSummary = document.getElementById('scheduleSummary');
        const scheduleContainer = document.getElementById('scheduleContainer');
        const tabButtons = document.querySelectorAll('.tab-button');
        const tabPanes = document.querySelectorAll('.tab-pane');
        
        // Tab functionality
        tabButtons.forEach(button => {
          button.addEventListener('click', function() {
            // Remove active class from all buttons and panes
            tabButtons.forEach(btn => btn.classList.remove('active'));
            tabPanes.forEach(pane => pane.classList.remove('active'));
            
            // Add active class to clicked button and corresponding pane
            this.classList.add('active');
            const tabId = this.getAttribute('data-tab');
            document.getElementById(tabId).classList.add('active');
          });
        });
        
        // Reset form
        resetFormButton.addEventListener('click', function() {
          scheduleCalculatorForm.reset();
          scheduleSummary.style.display = 'none';
          scheduleContainer.style.display = 'none';
        });
        
        // Handle form submission
        scheduleCalculatorForm.addEventListener('submit', function(e) {
          e.preventDefault();
          
          // Get form values
          const numCourts = parseInt(document.getElementById('numCourts').value);
          const numPlayers = parseInt(document.getElementById('numPlayers').value);
          const playersPerCourt = parseInt(document.getElementById('playersPerCourt').value);
          const numRounds = parseInt(document.getElementById('numRounds').value);
          const sessionLength = parseInt(document.getElementById('sessionLength').value);
          const scheduleType = document.getElementById('scheduleType').value;
          const allowPlayerRests = document.getElementById('allowPlayerRests').checked;
          
          // Basic validation
          if (numPlayers < playersPerCourt) {
            alert('Number of players must be at least equal to players per court');
            return;
          }
          
          // Call the schedule calculator module
          import('/js/scheduleCalculator.js').then(module => {
            const { generateSchedule, displaySchedule } = module;
            
            // Generate the schedule
            const schedule = generateSchedule({
              numCourts,
              numPlayers,
              playersPerCourt,
              numRounds,
              sessionLength,
              scheduleType,
              allowPlayerRests
            });
            
            if (schedule) {
              // Update summary statistics
              document.getElementById('totalPlayingTime').textContent = 
                `${schedule.totalPlayingTime} minutes`;
              document.getElementById('avgGamesPerPlayer').textContent = 
                schedule.avgGamesPerPlayer.toFixed(1);
              document.getElementById('totalSessions').textContent = 
                schedule.totalSessions;
              
              // Display the schedule
              displaySchedule(schedule, {
                roundElement: document.getElementById('roundSchedule'),
                playerElement: document.getElementById('playerSchedule'),
                courtElement: document.getElementById('courtSchedule')
              });
              
              // Show the schedule sections
              scheduleSummary.style.display = 'block';
              scheduleContainer.style.display = 'block';
              
              // Add event listeners for the schedule action buttons
              document.getElementById('saveScheduleButton').addEventListener('click', function() {
                // Implementation for saving the schedule will go here
                alert('Schedule saved successfully!');
              });
              
              document.getElementById('printScheduleButton').addEventListener('click', function() {
                window.print();
              });
              
              document.getElementById('exportScheduleButton').addEventListener('click', function() {
                // Implementation for exporting as CSV will go here
                const csv = convertScheduleToCSV(schedule);
                downloadCSV(csv, 'schedule.csv');
              });
            } else {
              alert('Failed to generate schedule. Please check your parameters and try again.');
            }
          });
        });
        
        // Helper function to convert schedule to CSV
        function convertScheduleToCSV(schedule) {
          // Implementation will go here
          let csv = 'Round,Court,Players\n';
          
          schedule.rounds.forEach((round, roundIndex) => {
            round.courts.forEach((court, courtIndex) => {
              const players = court.players.join(', ');
              csv += `${roundIndex + 1},${courtIndex + 1},"${players}"\n`;
            });
          });
          
          return csv;
        }
        
        // Helper function to download CSV
        function downloadCSV(csv, filename) {
          const blob = new Blob([csv], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
          const link = document.createElement('a');
          
          if (navigator.msSaveBlob) { // IE 10+
            navigator.msSaveBlob(blob, filename);
          } else {
            const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
            link.href = url;
            link.download = filename;
            document.body.appendChild(link);
            link.click();
            document.body.removeChild(link);
          }
        }
      });
    </script>
  </body>
</html>
```

```html
        const restingRounds = window.restingRounds || [];

                  <div class="schedule-cell">
                    <span class="label">Round:</span>
                    <span class="value">${matchData.round + 1}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div class="schedule-cell">
                    <span class="label">Court:</span>
                    <span class="value">${matchData.match.court + 1}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div class="schedule-cell">
                    <span class="label">My Team:</span>
                    <span class="value">${matchData.match[matchData.playerTeam].map(p => p.name).join(' & ')}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div class="schedule-cell">
                    <span class="label">Opposing Team:</span>
                    <span class="value">
                      ${matchData.match[matchData.playerTeam === 'teamA' ? 'teamB' : 'teamA'].map(p => p.name).join(' & ')}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div class="schedule-cell">
                    <span class="label">Score:</span>
                    <span class="value">${typeof matchData.match.teamAScore === "number" ? matchData.match.teamAScore : 0} / ${typeof matchData.match.teamBScore === "number" ? matchData.match.teamBScore : 0}</span>
                  </div>
                  ${showScoreButton ? `
                    <div class="schedule-cell">
                      <button class="btn btn--secondary btn-score" 
                        data-round="${matchData.round}"
                        data-matchindex="${matchData.matchIndex}"
                        data-eventid="${event._id}"
                        data-teama-score="${matchData.match.teamAScore || 0}"
                        data-teamb-score="${matchData.match.teamBScore || 0}">
                        ${matchData.hasScore ? 'Edit Score' : 'Enter Score'}
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  ` : ''}
                </div>
              `).join('')}
            </div>
          `;
          scheduleTable.innerHTML = tableHTML;
        } else {
          scheduleTable.innerHTML = '<p class="text-center">No matches found in your schedule.</p>';
        }
        
        // Score modal functionality
        if (showScoreButton) {
          const modal = document.getElementById('scoreModal');
          const closeModal = document.querySelector('.modal__close');
          const cancelModal = document.querySelector('.modal__cancel');
          const scoreForm = document.getElementById('scoreForm');
          
          // Open modal when clicking score buttons
          document.querySelectorAll('.btn-score').forEach(btn => {
            btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
              document.getElementById('scoreRound').value = btn.dataset.round;
              document.getElementById('scoreMatch').value = btn.dataset.matchindex;
              document.getElementById('scoreEvent').value = btn.dataset.eventid;
              document.getElementById('teamAScore').value = btn.dataset.teamaScore;
              document.getElementById('teamBScore').value = btn.dataset.teambScore;
              modal.classList.remove('hidden');
            });
          });
          
          // Close modal functions
          closeModal.addEventListener('click', () => modal.classList.add('hidden'));
          cancelModal.addEventListener('click', () => modal.classList.add('hidden'));
          
          // Submit form
          scoreForm.addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            try {
              // This would be handled by eventUpdateMatchScoreApiAction through initFormListeners
              // Just closing the modal here as the actual API call is handled elsewhere
              modal.classList.add('hidden');
            } catch (error) {
              console.error('Error updating score:', error);
            }
          });
        }
      });
    </script>
```

```js
/**
 * HTML View Controller
 * This controller handles serving HTML files directly
 */

import path from "path";
import fs from "fs";
import AppError from "../utils/appError";
import { controllerUtils } from "../utils/sharedLogic";

// Directory where HTML files are stored
const HTML_DIR = path.join(__dirname, "..", "public", "html");

/**
 * Helper function to find HTML file in supported directories
 * @param {string} templateName - Name of the template without .html extension
 * @returns {string|null} - Full path to HTML file or null if not found
 */
const findHtmlFile = (templateName) => {
  // Primary location for HTML files
  const htmlPath = path.join(HTML_DIR, `${templateName}.html`);

  // Check if the file exists
  if (fs.existsSync(htmlPath)) {
    return htmlPath;
  }

  // No HTML file found
  return null;
};

/**
 * Middleware to serve HTML files
 * This will be used for all routes to serve the appropriate HTML file
 */
const htmlMiddleware = (req, res, next) => {
  // Skip API routes and static files
  if (
    req.path.startsWith("/api/") ||
    req.path.match(/\.(js|css|png|jpg|jpeg|gif|ico|svg)$/)
  ) {
    return next();
  }

  // Extract the template name from the route
  // Handle different route patterns
  let templateName;
  const pathParts = req.path.split("/").filter(Boolean);

  // Special case for homepage
  if (req.path === "/") {
    templateName = "homepage";
  }
  // Handle routes with IDs like /events/get/123
  else if (pathParts.length >= 2 && pathParts[1] === "get" && pathParts[2]) {
    // For edit pages with IDs
    templateName = `edit${pathParts[0].charAt(0).toUpperCase() + pathParts[0].slice(0, -1)}`;
  }
  // Routes like /events/create
  else if (pathParts.length >= 2 && pathParts[1] === "create") {
    templateName = `create${pathParts[0].charAt(0).toUpperCase() + pathParts[0].slice(0, -1)}`;
  }
  // Routes like /events/showAll
  else if (pathParts.length >= 2) {
    templateName = pathParts[1];

    // Handle special templates
    const specialTemplates = {
      showAll: `showAll${pathParts[0].charAt(0).toUpperCase() + pathParts[0].slice(0, -1)}s`,
      myAccountDetails: "myAccountDetails",
      myPasswordUpdate: "myPasswordUpdate",
      myPasswordReset: "myPasswordReset",
      forgotPassword: "myPasswordForgot",
      showAllSchedules: "showAllSchedules",
      viewMasterSchedule: "viewMasterSchedule",
      viewMySchedule: "viewMySchedule",
      signup: "signUp",
      login: "login",
    };

    if (specialTemplates[templateName]) {
      templateName = specialTemplates[templateName];
    }
  }

  // Convert to standard naming convention if needed
  if (templateName && templateName.includes("-")) {
    templateName = templateName.replace(/-([a-z])/g, (match, letter) =>
      letter.toUpperCase()
    );
  }

  if (!templateName) {
    return next(
      new AppError(
        `Could not determine template name for path: ${req.path}`,
        404
      )
    );
  }

  // Find the HTML file
  const htmlPath = findHtmlFile(templateName);

  if (!htmlPath) {
    return next(
      new AppError(`HTML template not found: ${templateName}.html`, 404)
    );
  }

  // Serve the HTML file
  res.sendFile(htmlPath);
};

/**
 * Initialize HTML directory and set up middleware
 * @param {Express.Application} app - Express app
 */
const setupHtmlServing = (app) => {
  // Create HTML directory if it doesn't exist
  if (!fs.existsSync(HTML_DIR)) {
    fs.mkdirSync(HTML_DIR, { recursive: true });
    console.log(`Created HTML directory: ${HTML_DIR}`);
  }

  // Apply HTML middleware to all routes
  app.use(htmlMiddleware);

  console.log(
    "HTML direct serving enabled - all routes will be served from HTML files"
  );
};

/**
 * Serve an HTML file for a specific route
 * @param {string} template - Template name without .html extension
 * @returns {Function} - Express middleware function
 */
const serveHtml = (template) => {
  return (req, res, next) => {
    const htmlPath = findHtmlFile(template);

    if (!htmlPath) {
      return next(
        new AppError(`HTML template not found: ${template}.html`, 404)
      );
    }

    res.sendFile(htmlPath);
  };
};

/**
 * Serve an HTML file with data
 * @param {string} template - Template name without .html extension
 * @param {Function} dataHandler - Function to get data for the template
 * @returns {Function} - Express middleware function
 */
const serveHtmlWithData = (template, dataHandler) => {
  return async (req, res, next) => {
    try {
      // Get data
      const data = await dataHandler(req);

      // Find the HTML file
      const htmlPath = findHtmlFile(template);

      if (!htmlPath) {
        return next(
          new AppError(`HTML template not found: ${template}.html`, 404)
        );
      }

      // Read HTML file
      fs.readFile(htmlPath, "utf8", (err, html) => {
        if (err) {
          return next(
            new AppError(`Error reading HTML file: ${template}.html`, 500)
          );
        }

        // Inject data script
        const dataScript = `<script>window.templateData = ${JSON.stringify(data)};</script>`;
        html = html.replace("</head>", `${dataScript}</head>`);

        // Send HTML
        res.send(html);
      });
    } catch (err) {
      next(err);
    }
  };
};

/**
 * Helper for handling API responses consistently
 * @param {Function} handler - Async function that handles the request
 * @returns {Function} - Express middleware function
 */
const apiHandler = (handler) => {
  return async (req, res, next) => {
    try {
      const result = await handler(req);
      res.status(200).json({
        status: "success",
        data: result,
      });
    } catch (err) {
      next(err);
    }
  };
};

// Moved to utils/htmlUtils.js and consolidated with directHtmlController.js
// This file is now deprecated.
export { setupHtmlServing, serveHtml, serveHtmlWithData, apiHandler, HTML_DIR };

```

```new
    console.log(`Created HTML directory: ${HTML_DIR}`);
  }
  
  // Apply HTML middleware to all routes
  app.use(htmlMiddleware);
  
  console.log('HTML direct serving enabled - all routes will be served from HTML files');
};

/**
 * Serve an HTML file for a specific route
 * @param {string} template - Template name without .html extension
 * @returns {Function} - Express middleware function
 */
const serveHtml = (template) => {
  return (req, res, next) => {
    const htmlPath = findHtmlFile(template);
    
    if (!htmlPath) {
      return next(new AppError(`HTML template not found: ${template}.html`, 404));
    }
    
    res.sendFile(htmlPath);
  };
};

/**
 * Serve an HTML file with data
 * @param {string} template - Template name without .html extension
 * @param {Function} dataHandler - Function to get data for the template
 * @returns {Function} - Express middleware function
 */
const serveHtmlWithData = (template, dataHandler) => {
  return async (req, res, next) => {
    try {
      // Get data
      const data = await dataHandler(req);
      
      // Find the HTML file
      const htmlPath = findHtmlFile(template);
      
      if (!htmlPath) {
        return next(new AppError(`HTML template not found: ${template}.html`, 404));
      }
      
      // Read HTML file
      fs.readFile(htmlPath, 'utf8', (err, html) => {
        if (err) {
          return next(new AppError(`Error reading HTML file: ${template}.html`, 500));
        }
        
        // Inject data script
        const dataScript = `<script>window.templateData = ${JSON.stringify(data)};</script>`;
        html = html.replace('</head>', `${dataScript}</head>`);
        
        // Send HTML
        res.send(html);
      });
    } catch (err) {
      next(err);
    }
  };
};

/**
 * Helper for handling API responses consistently
 * @param {Function} handler - Async function that handles the request
 * @returns {Function} - Express middleware function
 */
const apiHandler = (handler) => {
  return async (req, res, next) => {
    try {
      const result = await handler(req);
      res.status(200).json({
        status: 'success',
        data: result
      });
    } catch (err) {
      next(err);
    }
  };
};

module.exports = {
  setupHtmlServing,
  serveHtml,
  serveHtmlWithData,
  apiHandler,
  HTML_DIR
};
```

## deprecated/noShowEvent.pug

*Size: 1789 bytes*

```pug
extends base

block content
  main.main
    section.section
      div.container
        h2.heading-secondary Mark No Show
        form#noShowForm.form-1-cols(method="post" action="/api/v1/events/noShow")
          label(for="eventId") Select Event
          select#eventId(name="eventId" required)
            each event in events
              option(value=event._id)= event.eventName + ' (' + event.eventDate.toLocaleDateString() + ')'
          label(for="userId") Select No Show User
          select#userId(name="userId" required)
            //- This will be dynamically populated via JS after event selection
          button.btn.btn--form(type="submit") Mark as No Show

  script.
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', async function() {
      const eventSelect = document.getElementById('eventId');
      const userSelect = document.getElementById('userId');
      async function populateUsers(eventId) {
        if (!eventId) {
          userSelect.innerHTML = '';
          return;
        }
        const res = await fetch(`/api/v1/events/${eventId}`);
        const event = await res.json();
        userSelect.innerHTML = '';
        if (event.data && event.data.event && event.data.event.eventBookings) {
          event.data.event.eventBookings.forEach(booking => {
            const opt = document.createElement('option');
            opt.value = booking.userId;
            opt.textContent = booking.userName;
            userSelect.appendChild(opt);
          });
        }
      }
      // Populate on page load for the first event
      if (eventSelect.value) {
        populateUsers(eventSelect.value);
      }
      // Populate on event change
      eventSelect.addEventListener('change', function() {
        populateUsers(this.value);
      });
    });
```

## deprecated/pagination.js

*Size: 2207 bytes*

```js
// utils/pagination.js

export function renderPagination(
  container,
  currentPage,
  totalPages,
  goToPageCallback
) {
  container.innerHTML = "";
  if (totalPages <= 1) return;
  const paginationList = document.createElement("ul");
  paginationList.className = "pagination-list";
  // Previous button
  const prevItem = document.createElement("li");
  const prevLink = document.createElement("a");
  prevLink.href = "#";
  prevLink.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-chevron-left"></i>';
  prevLink.className = "pagination-link";
  if (currentPage === 1) {
    prevItem.className = "pagination-item disabled";
  } else {
    prevItem.className = "pagination-item";
    prevLink.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      goToPageCallback(currentPage - 1);
    });
  }
  prevItem.appendChild(prevLink);
  paginationList.appendChild(prevItem);
  // Page numbers
  const startPage = Math.max(1, currentPage - 2);
  const endPage = Math.min(totalPages, startPage + 4);
  for (let i = startPage; i <= endPage; i++) {
    const pageItem = document.createElement("li");
    pageItem.className = "pagination-item";
    const pageLink = document.createElement("a");
    pageLink.href = "#";
    pageLink.textContent = i.toString();
    pageLink.className = "pagination-link";
    if (i === currentPage) {
      pageLink.className += " active";
    } else {
      pageLink.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        goToPageCallback(i);
      });
    }
    pageItem.appendChild(pageLink);
    paginationList.appendChild(pageItem);
  }
  // Next button
  const nextItem = document.createElement("li");
  const nextLink = document.createElement("a");
  nextLink.href = "#";
  nextLink.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-chevron-right"></i>';
  nextLink.className = "pagination-link";
  if (currentPage === totalPages) {
    nextItem.className = "pagination-item disabled";
  } else {
    nextItem.className = "pagination-item";
    nextLink.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      goToPageCallback(currentPage + 1);
    });
  }
  nextItem.appendChild(nextLink);
  paginationList.appendChild(nextItem);
  container.appendChild(paginationList);
}

```

```pug
			div.container
```

```pug
				if restingRounds && restingRounds.length
					div.resting-info.center-text
						| You will be resting in round(s):
						each roundNum, idx in restingRounds
							span.label= ' ' + roundNum + (idx < restingRounds.length - 1 ? ',' : '')
				else
					div.resting-info.center-text
```

```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
    <meta
      name="description"
      content="RallyPoint - Sports scheduling platform"
    />
    <link rel="icon" href="/img/favicon.png" />
    <link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="/img/apple-touch-icon.png" />
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" />
    <link
      href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Rubik:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap"
      rel="stylesheet"
    />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="/css/rallypoint.css" />
    <link
      rel="stylesheet"
      href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/5.15.4/css/all.min.css"
    />
    <script type="module" src="/js/index.js" defer></script>
    <script type="module" src="/js/navigation.js" defer></script>
    <title>RallyPoint - Sports Scheduling Platform</title>
    <% if (locals.userRole) { %>
    <input type="hidden" id="templateUserRole" value="<%= userRole %>" />
    <% } else if (locals.user && locals.user.role) { %>
    <input type="hidden" id="templateUserRole" value="<%= user.role %>" />
    <% } %>
  </head>
  <body>
    <header>
      <h1>RallyPoint</h1>
    </header>

    <nav>
      <!-- Navigation items will vary based on user role and login status -->
      <a href="/" aria-label="Home">
        <i class="fas fa-home"></i>
      </a>

      <!-- For logged-in users -->
      <a href="/events/myBrowse" aria-label="My Events" class="logged-in-only">
        <i class="fas fa-calendar-check"></i>
      </a>
      <a
        href="/events/browseNew"
        aria-label="Find Events"
        class="logged-in-only"
      >
        <i class="fas fa-search"></i>
      </a>

      <!-- For admin users -->
      <a href="/events/create" aria-label="Create Event" class="admin-only">
        <i class="fas fa-plus-circle"></i>
      </a>
      <a href="/events/showAll" aria-label="All Events" class="admin-only">
        <i class="fas fa-calendar-alt"></i>
      </a>
      <a href="/users/showAll" aria-label="Manage Users" class="admin-only">
        <i class="fas fa-users-cog"></i>
      </a>

      <!-- For all users -->
      <a href="/me/account" aria-label="Profile" class="logged-in-only">
        <i class="fas fa-user"></i>
      </a>

      <!-- Login/Logout -->
      <a href="/me/login" aria-label="Login" class="logged-out-only">
        <i class="fas fa-sign-in-alt"></i>
      </a>
      <a href="#" id="logoutButton" aria-label="Logout" class="logged-in-only">
        <i class="fas fa-sign-out-alt"></i>
      </a>
    </nav>

    <main class="main">
      <section class="section">
        <div class="container">
          <!-- Content will be injected here -->
        </div>
      </section>
    </main>

    <footer class="footer text-center mt-lg">
      <p>&copy; 2025 RallyPoint. All rights reserved.</p>
    </footer>

    <!-- Alert container for displaying messages -->
    <div id="alert" class="alert hidden"></div>

    <script type="module">
      document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
        // Get user role from session or data attribute
        const userRole = document.body.dataset.userRole || "guest";
        const isLoggedIn = userRole !== "guest";

        // Show/hide navigation items based on role
        document.querySelectorAll(".logged-in-only").forEach((el) => {
          el.style.display = isLoggedIn ? "inline-block" : "none";
        });

        document.querySelectorAll(".logged-out-only").forEach((el) => {
          el.style.display = isLoggedIn ? "none" : "inline-block";
        });

        document.querySelectorAll(".admin-only").forEach((el) => {
          el.style.display =
            userRole === "clubAdmin" || userRole === "pickleAdmin"
              ? "inline-block"
              : "none";
        });
      });
    </script>
  </body>
</html>

```

```html
                      <input
```
```html
                        type="number"
                        id="eventWaitListSize"
                        name="eventWaitListSize"
                        class="form-control"
                        required
                      />
                    </div>

                    <div class="form-group">
                      <div class="checkbox-group">
                        <label class="toggle-switch">
                          <input type="checkbox" id="active" name="active" />
                          <span class="slider"></span>
                        </label>
                        <span class="toggle-label">Make event active</span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <!-- Right Column - Schedule Calculator -->
                  <div class="form-column">
                    <div class="calculator-box">
                      <div class="calculator-header">
                        <h3 class="section-title">Schedule Calculator</h3>
                        <div class="calculator-icon-wrapper">
                          <i class="fas fa-calculator calculator-icon"></i>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      <div class="form-group">
                        <div class="checkbox-group">
                          <label class="toggle-switch">
                            <input
                              type="checkbox"
                              id="doublesToggle"
                              name="doublesToggle"
                              checked
                            />
                            <span class="slider"></span>
                          </label>
                          <span class="toggle-label">Doubles Format</span>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      <div class="form-group">
                        <label for="numCourts">Number of Courts</label>
                        <select
                          id="numCourts"
                          name="numCourts"
                          class="form-control"
                        >
                          <option value="" disabled selected>
                            Choose courts
                          </option>
                        </select>
                      </div>

                      <!-- Schedule Options -->
                      <div
                        id="scheduleOptions"
                        class="schedule-options-container"
                      >
                        <!-- Will be populated by JS -->
                      </div>

                      <!-- Schedule Preview -->
                      <div
                        id="schedulePreview"
                        class="schedule-preview-container"
                      >
                        <!-- Will be populated by JS -->
                      </div>

                      <input
                        type="hidden"
                        id="selectedScheduleConfig"
                        name="selectedScheduleConfig"
                      />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div class="form-actions">
                  <a href="/events/showAll" class="btn btn-outline">Cancel</a>
                  <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary">
                    Create Event
                  </button>
                </div>
              </form>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>
    </main>

    <!-- Alert container for displaying messages -->
    <div id="alert" class="alert hidden"></div>

    <script>
      document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
        const createEventForm = document.getElementById("createEventForm");

        createEventForm.addEventListener("submit", async function (e) {
          e.preventDefault();

          const formData = new FormData(createEventForm);
          const eventData = {};

          // Convert FormData to object
          for (const [key, value] of formData.entries()) {
            if (key === "active" || key === "doublesToggle") {
              eventData[key] = true; // Checkbox is checked
            } else if (key === "selectedScheduleConfig" && value) {
              eventData[key] = JSON.parse(value);
            } else {
              eventData[key] = value;
            }
          }

          // Handle unchecked checkboxes
          if (!formData.has("active")) {
            eventData.active = false;
          }

          if (!formData.has("doublesToggle")) {
            eventData.doublesToggle = false;
          }

          try {
            const response = await fetch("/api/v1/events", {
              method: "POST",
              headers: {
                "Content-Type": "application/json",
              },
              body: JSON.stringify(eventData),
            });

            const data = await response.json();

            if (response.ok) {
              // Only show the showAlert message, not the browser alert
              window.location.href = `/events/showAll`;
            } else {
              // Only log the error, the API will trigger the showAlert
              console.error(
                "Error creating event:",
                data.message || "Failed to create event"
              );
            }
          } catch (err) {
            console.error("Error creating event:", err);
            // Only log the error, don't show alert
          }
        });
      });
    </script>
  </body>
</html>
```

```html
    <main class="main">
      <section class="section">
        <div class="container">
          <div class="card">
            <div class="card-header">
              <h2 class="card-title">Create User</h2>
            </div>

            <div class="card-body">
              <form id="createUserForm" class="form">
                <div class="form-group">
                  <label for="name">Name</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    id="name"
                    name="name"
                    class="form-control"
                    required
                  />
                </div>

                <div class="form-group">
                  <label for="email">Email</label>
                  <input
                    type="email"
                    id="email"
                    name="email"
                    class="form-control"
                    placeholder="user@example.com"
                    required
                  />
                </div>

                <div class="form-group">
                  <label for="mobile">Mobile</label>
                  <input
                    type="tel"
                    id="mobile"
                    name="mobile"
                    class="form-control"
                    required
                  />
                </div>

                <div class="form-group">
                  <label for="role">Role</label>
                  <select id="role" name="role" class="form-control">
                    <option value="user" selected>User</option>
                    <option value="admin">Admin</option>
                  </select>
                </div>

                <div class="form-group">
                  <label for="password">Password</label>
                  <div class="password-input-wrapper">
                    <input
                      type="password"
                      id="password"
                      name="password"
                      class="form-control"
                      required
                    />
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      class="password-toggle"
                      aria-label="Toggle password visibility"
                    >
                      <i class="fas fa-eye"></i>
                    </button>
                  </div>
                  <div class="password-strength-meter">
                    <div class="strength-bar"></div>
                  </div>
                  <div class="password-feedback"></div>
                </div>

                <div class="form-group">
                  <label for="passwordConfirm">Confirm Password</label>
                  <div class="password-input-wrapper">
                    <input
                      type="password"
                      id="passwordConfirm"
                      name="passwordConfirm"
                      class="form-control"
                      required
                    />
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      class="password-toggle"
                      aria-label="Toggle password visibility"
                    >
                      <i class="fas fa-eye"></i>
                    </button>
                  </div>
                  <div class="password-match-message"></div>
                </div>

                <div class="form-group">
                  <div class="checkbox-group">
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      id="active"
                      name="active"
                      class="checkbox-input"
                      checked
                    />
                    <label for="active" class="checkbox-label"
                      >User is active</label
                    >

                </div>
              </form>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>
    </main>

    <script>
      document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
        const createUserForm = document.getElementById("createUserForm");

        createUserForm.addEventListener("submit", async function (e) {
          e.preventDefault();

          // Validate password match
          const password = document.getElementById("password").value;
          const passwordConfirm =
            document.getElementById("passwordConfirm").value;

          if (password !== passwordConfirm) {
            const matchMessage = document.querySelector(
              ".password-match-message"
            );
            matchMessage.textContent = "Passwords do not match";
            matchMessage.classList.add("error-message");
            return;
          }

          const formData = new FormData(createUserForm);
          const userData = {};

          // Convert FormData to object
          for (const [key, value] of formData.entries()) {
            if (key === "active") {
              userData[key] = true; // Checkbox is checked
            } else {
              userData[key] = value;
            }
          }

          // Handle unchecked checkboxes
          if (!formData.has("active")) {
            userData.active = false;
          }

          try {
            const response = await fetch("/api/v1/users", {
              method: "POST",
              headers: {
                "Content-Type": "application/json",
              },
              body: JSON.stringify(userData),
            });

            const data = await response.json();

            if (response.ok) {
              // Show success message and redirect
              alert("User created successfully!");
              window.location.href = `/users/showAll`;
            } else {
              // Show error message
              alert(`Error: ${data.message || "Failed to create user"}`);
            }
          } catch (err) {
            console.error("Error creating user:", err);
            alert("An error occurred while creating the user");
          }
        });
      });
    </script>
  </body>
</html>
```

```html
          <a href="/debug/admin" target="_blank"
            >http://localhost:3000/debug/admin</a
          >

      placeholder="Paste your debug output here..."
    ></textarea>
```
