```html
        </div>
        <div class="modal-body">
          <p>
            Are you sure you want to delete this event? This action cannot be
            undone.
          </p>
        </div>
        <div class="modal-footer">
          <button id="confirmDeleteButton" class="btn btn-danger">
            Delete
          </button>
          <button id="cancelDeleteButton" class="btn btn-outline">
            Cancel
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <script>
      document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
        const editEventForm = document.getElementById("editEventForm");
        const addSessionButton = document.getElementById("addSessionButton");
        const sessionsContainer = document.getElementById("sessionsContainer");
        const deleteEventButton = document.getElementById("deleteEventButton");
        const confirmationModal = document.getElementById("confirmationModal");
        const confirmDeleteButton = document.getElementById(
          "confirmDeleteButton"
        );
        const cancelDeleteButton =
          document.getElementById("cancelDeleteButton");
        const modalClose = document.querySelector(".modal-close");

        // Get the event ID from the URL
        const eventId = window.location.pathname.split("/").pop();
        let sessions = [];

        // Fetch event data
        fetch(`/api/v1/events/${eventId}`)
          .then((response) => response.json())
          .then((data) => {
            if (data.status === "success" && data.data && data.data.event) {
              const event = data.data.event;

              // Populate form fields
              document.getElementById("name").value = event.name || "";
              document.getElementById("eventType").value =
                event.eventType || "social";
              document.getElementById("location").value = event.location || "";
              document.getElementById("description").value =
                event.description || "";
              document.getElementById("maxPlayers").value =
                event.maxPlayers || "";
              document.getElementById("skillLevel").value =
                event.skillLevel || "all";
              document.getElementById("price").value = event.price || "0";
              document.getElementById("status").value =
                event.status || "published";
              document.getElementById("registrationOpen").checked =
                event.registrationOpen;

              // Format dates and times
              if (event.startDate) {
                const startDate = new Date(event.startDate);
                document.getElementById("startDate").value = startDate
                  .toISOString()
                  .split("T")[0];

                if (event.startTime) {
                  document.getElementById("startTime").value = event.startTime;
                } else {
                  document.getElementById("startTime").value = "09:00";
                }
              }

              if (event.endDate) {
                const endDate = new Date(event.endDate);
                document.getElementById("endDate").value = endDate
                  .toISOString()
                  .split("T")[0];

                if (event.endTime) {
                  document.getElementById("endTime").value = event.endTime;
                } else {
                  document.getElementById("endTime").value = "17:00";
                }
              }

              // Load sessions
              if (event.sessions && event.sessions.length > 0) {
                sessions = event.sessions;
                renderSessions();
              }
            } else {
              alert("Failed to load event data");
            }
          })
          .catch((err) => {
            console.error("Error fetching event data:", err);
            alert("An error occurred while loading event data");
          });

        // Add session
        addSessionButton.addEventListener("click", function () {
          const newSession = {
            id: Date.now(), // Unique ID for client-side tracking
            name: `Session ${sessions.length + 1}`,
            startTime: "09:00",
            endTime: "10:00",
            maxPlayers: 16,
            courts: 4,
          };

          sessions.push(newSession);
          renderSessions();
        });

        // Render sessions
        function renderSessions() {
          sessionsContainer.innerHTML = "";

          sessions.forEach((session, index) => {
            const sessionDiv = document.createElement("div");
            sessionDiv.className = "session-card";
            sessionDiv.dataset.sessionId = session.id;

            sessionDiv.innerHTML = `
              <div class="session-header">
                <h4>Session ${index + 1}</h4>
                <button type="button" class="btn-icon remove-session" data-session-id="${session.id}">
                  <i class="fas fa-times"></i>
                </button>
              </div>
              
              <div class="form-row">
                <div class="form-group col-md-6">
                  <label for="sessionName-${session.id}">Session Name</label>
                  <input type="text" id="sessionName-${session.id}" name="sessionName-${session.id}" 
                    class="form-control" value="${session.name || ""}">
                </div>
                
                <div class="form-group col-md-3">
                  <label for="sessionStart-${session.id}">Start Time</label>
                  <input type="time" id="sessionStart-${session.id}" name="sessionStart-${session.id}" 
                    class="form-control" value="${session.startTime || "09:00"}">
                </div>
                
                <div class="form-group col-md-3">
                  <label for="sessionEnd-${session.id}">End Time</label>
                  <input type="time" id="sessionEnd-${session.id}" name="sessionEnd-${session.id}" 
                    class="form-control" value="${session.endTime || "10:00"}">
                </div>
              </div>
              
              <div class="form-row">
                <div class="form-group col-md-6">
                  <label for="sessionMaxPlayers-${session.id}">Max Players</label>
                  <input type="number" id="sessionMaxPlayers-${session.id}" name="sessionMaxPlayers-${session.id}" 
                    class="form-control" min="1" value="${session.maxPlayers || 16}">
                </div>
                
                <div class="form-group col-md-6">
                  <label for="sessionCourts-${session.id}">Number of Courts</label>
                  <input type="number" id="sessionCourts-${session.id}" name="sessionCourts-${session.id}" 
                    class="form-control" min="1" value="${session.courts || 4}">
                </div>
              </div>
            `;

            sessionsContainer.appendChild(sessionDiv);
          });

          // Add event listeners for remove session buttons
          document.querySelectorAll(".remove-session").forEach((button) => {
            button.addEventListener("click", function () {
              const sessionId = parseInt(this.dataset.sessionId);
              sessions = sessions.filter((session) => session.id !== sessionId);
              renderSessions();
            });
          });
        }

        // Handle form submission
        editEventForm.addEventListener("submit", async function (e) {
          e.preventDefault();

          // Gather form data
          const formData = new FormData(editEventForm);
          const eventData = {};

          // Convert FormData to object (for basic fields)
          for (const [key, value] of formData.entries()) {
            if (!key.startsWith("session")) {
              // Skip session fields
              if (key === "registrationOpen") {
                eventData[key] = true; // Checkbox is checked
              } else {
                eventData[key] = value;
              }
            }
          }

          // Handle unchecked checkboxes
          if (!formData.has("registrationOpen")) {
            eventData.registrationOpen = false;
          }

          // Update sessions data from form
          const updatedSessions = sessions.map((session) => {
            const sessionId = session.id;
            return {
              id: session.id,
              name: document.getElementById(`sessionName-${sessionId}`).value,
              startTime: document.getElementById(`sessionStart-${sessionId}`)
                .value,
              endTime: document.getElementById(`sessionEnd-${sessionId}`).value,
              maxPlayers: parseInt(
                document.getElementById(`sessionMaxPlayers-${sessionId}`).value
              ),
              courts: parseInt(
                document.getElementById(`sessionCourts-${sessionId}`).value
              ),
            };
          });

          eventData.sessions = updatedSessions;

          try {
            const response = await fetch(`/api/v1/events/${eventId}`, {
              method: "PATCH",
              headers: {
                "Content-Type": "application/json",
              },
              body: JSON.stringify(eventData),
            });

            const data = await response.json();

            if (response.ok) {
              // Show success message
              alert("Event updated successfully!");

              // Redirect to event browse page
              window.location.href = "/events/myBrowse";
            } else {
              // Show error message
              alert(`Error: ${data.message || "Failed to update event"}`);
            }
          } catch (err) {
            console.error("Error updating event:", err);
            alert("An error occurred while updating the event");
          }
        });

        // Delete event
        deleteEventButton.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
          e.preventDefault();
          confirmationModal.style.display = "flex";
        });

        // Confirmation modal
        confirmDeleteButton.addEventListener("click", async function () {
          try {
            const response = await fetch(`/api/v1/events/${eventId}`, {
              method: "DELETE",
            });

            if (response.ok) {
              // Show success message
              alert("Event deleted successfully!");

              // Redirect to event browse page
              window.location.href = "/events/myBrowse";
            } else {
              const data = await response.json();
              // Show error message
              alert(`Error: ${data.message || "Failed to delete event"}`);
            }
          } catch (err) {
            console.error("Error deleting event:", err);
            alert("An error occurred while deleting the event");
          } finally {
            confirmationModal.style.display = "none";
          }
        });

        // Cancel delete
        cancelDeleteButton.addEventListener("click", function () {
          confirmationModal.style.display = "none";
        });

        // Close modal when clicking the X
        modalClose.addEventListener("click", function () {
          confirmationModal.style.display = "none";
        });

        // Close modal when clicking outside
        window.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
          if (e.target === confirmationModal) {
            confirmationModal.style.display = "none";
          }
        });
      });
    </script>
  </body>
</html>
```

```html
                      >Maximum Sessions per Event</label
                    >

                    <input

                      id="maxLoginAttempts"
                      name="maxLoginAttempts"
                      class="form-control"
                      min="1"
                    />
                  </div>

                  <div class="form-group">
                    <label for="passwordResetTimeLimit"
                      >Password Reset Time Limit (minutes)</label
                    >
                    <input
                      type="number"
                      id="passwordResetTimeLimit"
                      name="passwordResetTimeLimit"
                      class="form-control"
                      min="5"
                    />
                  </div>

                  <div class="form-group">
                    <label for="sessionTimeout"
                      >Session Timeout (minutes)</label
                    >
                    <input
                      type="number"
                      id="sessionTimeout"
                      name="sessionTimeout"
                      class="form-control"
                      min="5"
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div class="form-actions">
                  <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary">
                    Save Settings
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    id="resetToDefaultsButton"
                    class="btn btn-danger"
                  >
                    Reset to Defaults
                  </button>
                </div>
              </form>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

    <script>
      document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
        const systemSettingsForm =
          document.getElementById("systemSettingsForm");
        const resetToDefaultsButton = document.getElementById(
          "resetToDefaultsButton"
        );

        // Fetch current settings
        fetch("/api/v1/settings")
          .then((response) => response.json())
          .then((data) => {
            if (data.status === "success" && data.data && data.data.settings) {
              const settings = data.data.settings;

              // Populate form fields with current settings
              for (const key in settings) {
                const element = document.getElementById(key);
                if (element) {
                  if (element.type === "checkbox") {
                    element.checked = settings[key];
                  } else {
                    element.value = settings[key];
                  }
                }
              }
            } else {
              alert("Failed to load system settings");
            }
          })
          .catch((err) => {
            console.error("Error fetching system settings:", err);
            alert("An error occurred while loading system settings");
          });

        // Handle form submission
        systemSettingsForm.addEventListener("submit", async function (e) {
          e.preventDefault();

          const formData = new FormData(systemSettingsForm);
          const settingsData = {};

          // Convert FormData to object
          for (const [key, value] of formData.entries()) {
            if (document.getElementById(key).type === "checkbox") {
              settingsData[key] = true; // Checkbox is checked
            } else if (document.getElementById(key).type === "number") {
              settingsData[key] = parseInt(value, 10);
            } else {
              settingsData[key] = value;
            }
          }

          // Handle unchecked checkboxes
          const checkboxes = systemSettingsForm.querySelectorAll(
            'input[type="checkbox"]'
          );
          checkboxes.forEach((checkbox) => {
            if (!formData.has(checkbox.name)) {
              settingsData[checkbox.name] = false;
            }
          });

          try {
            const response = await fetch("/api/v1/settings", {
              method: "PATCH",
              headers: {
                "Content-Type": "application/json",
              },
              body: JSON.stringify(settingsData),
            });

            const data = await response.json();

            if (response.ok) {
              // Show success message
              alert("System settings updated successfully!");
            } else {
              // Show error message
              alert(
                `Error: ${data.message || "Failed to update system settings"}`
              );
            }
          } catch (err) {
            console.error("Error updating system settings:", err);
            alert("An error occurred while updating system settings");
          }
        });

        // Handle reset to defaults
        resetToDefaultsButton.addEventListener("click", async function () {
          if (
            confirm(
              "Are you sure you want to reset all settings to default values? This cannot be undone."
            )
          ) {
            try {
              const response = await fetch("/api/v1/settings/reset", {
                method: "POST",
              });

              const data = await response.json();

              if (response.ok) {
                // Show success message
                alert("System settings reset to defaults");

                // Reload the page to show the default settings
                window.location.reload();
              } else {
                // Show error message
                alert(
                  `Error: ${data.message || "Failed to reset system settings"}`
                );
              }
            } catch (err) {
              console.error("Error resetting system settings:", err);
              alert("An error occurred while resetting system settings");
            }
          }
        });
      });
    </script>
  </body>
</html>
```

```html
    <main class="main">
      <section class="section">
        <div class="container">
          <div class="card">
            <div class="card-header">

            </div>

            <div class="card-body">
              <form id="editUserForm" class="form">
                <div class="form-group">
                  <label for="name">Name</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    id="name"
                    name="name"
                    class="form-control"
                    required
                  />
                </div>

                <div class="form-group">
                  <label for="email">Email</label>
                  <input
                    type="email"
                    id="email"
                    name="email"
                    class="form-control"
                    required
                  />
                </div>

                <div class="form-group">
                  <label for="mobile">Mobile</label>
                  <input
                    type="tel"
                    id="mobile"
                    name="mobile"
                    class="form-control"
                    required
                  />
                </div>

                <div class="form-group">
                  <label for="role">Role</label>
                  <select id="role" name="role" class="form-control">
                    <option value="user">User</option>
                    <option value="admin">Admin</option>
                  </select>
                </div>

                <div class="form-group">
                  <div class="checkbox-group">
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      id="active"
                      name="active"
                      class="checkbox-input"
                    />
                    <label for="active" class="checkbox-label"
                      >User is active</label
                    >
                  </div>
                </div>

                <!-- Hidden field for user ID -->
                <input type="hidden" id="userId" name="userId" />

                <div class="form-actions">
                  <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary">
                    Save Changes
                  </button>
                  <a href="/users/showAll" class="btn btn-outline">Cancel</a>
                </div>
              </form>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>
    </main>

    <script>
      document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
        const editUserForm = document.getElementById("editUserForm");
        const userId = window.location.pathname.split("/").pop();

        // Fetch user data
        fetch(`/api/v1/users/${userId}`)
          .then((response) => response.json())
          .then((data) => {
            if (data.status === "success" && data.data && data.data.user) {
              const user = data.data.user;

              // Populate form fields
              document.getElementById("name").value = user.name || "";
              document.getElementById("email").value = user.email || "";
              document.getElementById("mobile").value = user.mobile || "";
              document.getElementById("userId").value = user._id;
              document.getElementById("active").checked = user.active;

              // Set role
              const roleSelect = document.getElementById("role");
              for (let i = 0; i < roleSelect.options.length; i++) {
                if (roleSelect.options[i].value === user.role) {
                  roleSelect.selectedIndex = i;
                  break;
                }
              }
            } else {
              alert("Failed to load user data");
            }
          })
          .catch((err) => {
            console.error("Error fetching user data:", err);
            alert("An error occurred while loading user data");
          });

        // Handle form submission
        editUserForm.addEventListener("submit", async function (e) {
          e.preventDefault();

          const formData = new FormData(editUserForm);
          const userData = {};

          // Convert FormData to object
          for (const [key, value] of formData.entries()) {
            if (key === "active") {
              userData[key] = true; // Checkbox is checked
            } else if (key !== "userId") {
              // Skip userId, we'll use it in the URL
              userData[key] = value;
            }
          }

          // Handle unchecked checkboxes
          if (!formData.has("active")) {
            userData.active = false;
          }

          try {
            const response = await fetch(
              `/api/v1/users/${formData.get("userId")}`,
              {
                method: "PATCH",
                headers: {
                  "Content-Type": "application/json",
                },
                body: JSON.stringify(userData),
              }
            );

            const data = await response.json();

            if (response.ok) {
              // Show success message and redirect
              alert("User updated successfully!");
              window.location.href = `/users/showAll`;
            } else {
              // Show error message
              alert(`Error: ${data.message || "Failed to update user"}`);
            }
          } catch (err) {
            console.error("Error updating user:", err);
            alert("An error occurred while updating the user");
          }
        });
      });
    </script>
  </body>
</html>
```

```html
    />
    <script type="module" src="/js/index.js" defer></script>
    <title>RallyPoint - Error</title>
  </head>
  <body>
    <header>
      <h1>RallyPoint</h1>
    </header>

    <main class="main">
      <section class="section">
        <div class="container">
          <div class="error-container">
            <div class="error-icon">
              <i class="fas fa-exclamation-triangle"></i>
            </div>

            <h2 id="errorTitle" class="error-title">
              Oops! Something went wrong
            </h2>

            <p id="errorMessage" class="error-message">
              We're sorry, but there was an error processing your request.
            </p>

            <div class="error-actions">
              <a href="/" class="btn btn-primary">Go to Homepage</a>
              <button id="goBackButton" class="btn btn-outline">Go Back</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>
    </main>

    <script>
      document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
        const errorTitle = document.getElementById("errorTitle");
        const errorMessage = document.getElementById("errorMessage");
        const goBackButton = document.getElementById("goBackButton");

        // Extract error information from URL params
        const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
        const statusCode = urlParams.get("statusCode");
        const message = urlParams.get("message");

        // Update error title based on status code
        if (statusCode) {
          if (statusCode === "404") {
            errorTitle.textContent = "Page Not Found";
          } else if (statusCode === "403") {
            errorTitle.textContent = "Access Forbidden";
          } else if (statusCode === "500") {
            errorTitle.textContent = "Server Error";
          } else {
            errorTitle.textContent = `Error ${statusCode}`;
          }
        }

        // Update error message if provided
        if (message) {
          errorMessage.textContent = message;
        }

        // Set up go back button
        goBackButton.addEventListener("click", function () {
          window.history.back();
        });
```
```html
      });
    </script>
  </body>
</html>
```

```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
    <meta name="description" content="RallyPoint - Forgot Password" />
    <link rel="icon" href="/img/favicon.png" />
    <link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="/img/apple-touch-icon.png" />
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" />
    <link
      href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Rubik:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap"
      rel="stylesheet"
    />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="/css/rallypoint.css" />
    <link
      rel="stylesheet"
      href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/5.15.4/css/all.min.css"
    />
    <script type="module" src="/js/index.js" defer></script>
    <title>RallyPoint - Forgot Password</title>
  </head>
  <body>
    <header>
      <h1>RallyPoint</h1>
    </header>

    <main class="main">
      <section class="section">
        <div class="container">
          <div class="card mx-auto" style="max-width: 500px">
            <div class="card-header">
              <h2 class="card-title">Forgot Your Password?</h2>
            </div>

            <div class="card-body">
              <p class="mb-4">
                Please enter your email address. We'll send you a link to reset
                your password.
              </p>

              <form id="forgotPasswordForm" class="form">
                <div class="form-group">
                  <label for="email">Email address</label>
                  <input
                    type="email"
                    id="email"
                    name="email"
                    class="form-control"
                    required
                  />
                </div>

                <div class="form-actions">
                  <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary">
                    Send Reset Link
                  </button>
                  <a href="/login" class="btn btn-outline">Back to Login</a>
                </div>
              </form>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>
    </main>

    <script>
      document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
        const forgotPasswordForm =
          document.getElementById("forgotPasswordForm");

        forgotPasswordForm.addEventListener("submit", async function (e) {
          e.preventDefault();

          const email = document.getElementById("email").value;

          try {
            const response = await fetch("/api/v1/users/forgotPassword", {
              method: "POST",
              headers: {
                "Content-Type": "application/json",
              },
              body: JSON.stringify({ email }),
            });

            const data = await response.json();

            if (response.ok) {
              // Clear the form
              forgotPasswordForm.reset();

              // Show success message
              alert("Password reset link sent to your email!");

              // Redirect to login page after a delay
              setTimeout(() => {
                window.location.href = "/login";
              }, 3000);
            } else {
              // Show error message
              alert(`Error: ${data.message || "Failed to send reset link"}`);
            }
          } catch (err) {
            console.error("Error sending reset link:", err);
            alert("An error occurred while sending the reset link");
          }
        });
      });
    </script>
  </body>
</html>
```

## public/html/myPasswordReset.html

*Size: 8292 bytes*

```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
    <meta name="description" content="RallyPoint - Reset Password" />
    <link rel="icon" href="/img/favicon.png" />
    <link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="/img/apple-touch-icon.png" />
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" />
    <link
      href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Rubik:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap"
      rel="stylesheet"
    />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="/css/rallypoint.css" />
    <link
      rel="stylesheet"
      href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/5.15.4/css/all.min.css"
    />
    <script type="module" src="/js/index.js" defer></script>
    <script type="module" src="/js/passwordValidator.js" defer></script>
    <title>RallyPoint - Reset Password</title>
  </head>
  <body>
    <header>
      <h1>RallyPoint</h1>
    </header>

    <main class="main">
      <section class="section">
        <div class="container">
          <div class="card mx-auto" style="max-width: 500px">
            <div class="card-header">
              <h2 class="card-title">Reset Your Password</h2>
            </div>

            <div class="card-body">
              <form id="resetPasswordForm" class="form">
                <div class="form-group">
                  <label for="password">New Password</label>
                  <div class="password-input-group">
                    <input
                      type="password"
                      id="password"
                      name="password"
                      class="form-control"
                      required
                    />
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      id="togglePassword"
                      class="password-toggle"
                      aria-label="Toggle password visibility"
                    >
                      <i class="far fa-eye"></i>
                    </button>
                  </div>
                  <div class="password-strength-meter">
                    <div class="strength-meter-bar" id="strengthMeter"></div>
                  </div>
                  <div id="passwordFeedback" class="password-feedback"></div>
                </div>

                <div class="form-group">
                  <label for="passwordConfirm">Confirm Password</label>
                  <div class="password-input-group">
                    <input
                      type="password"
                      id="passwordConfirm"
                      name="passwordConfirm"
                      class="form-control"
                      required
                    />
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      id="togglePasswordConfirm"
                      class="password-toggle"
                      aria-label="Toggle password visibility"
                    >
                      <i class="far fa-eye"></i>
                    </button>
                  </div>
                  <div
                    id="passwordMatchFeedback"
                    class="password-feedback"
                  ></div>
                </div>

                <div class="form-actions">
                  <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary">
                    Reset Password
                  </button>
                  <a href="/login" class="btn btn-outline">Cancel</a>
                </div>
              </form>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>
    </main>

    <script>
      document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
        const resetPasswordForm = document.getElementById("resetPasswordForm");
        const passwordInput = document.getElementById("password");
        const passwordConfirmInput = document.getElementById("passwordConfirm");
        const togglePassword = document.getElementById("togglePassword");
        const togglePasswordConfirm = document.getElementById(
          "togglePasswordConfirm"
        );
        const strengthMeter = document.getElementById("strengthMeter");
        const passwordFeedback = document.getElementById("passwordFeedback");
        const passwordMatchFeedback = document.getElementById(
          "passwordMatchFeedback"
        );

        // Get the token from the URL
        const token = window.location.pathname.split("/").pop();

        // Import the password validator
        import("/js/passwordValidator.js").then((module) => {
          const {
            validatePassword,
            togglePasswordVisibility,
            checkPasswordsMatch,
          } = module;

          // Set up password visibility toggle
          togglePassword.addEventListener("click", () => {
            togglePasswordVisibility(passwordInput, togglePassword);
          });

          togglePasswordConfirm.addEventListener("click", () => {
            togglePasswordVisibility(
              passwordConfirmInput,
              togglePasswordConfirm
            );
          });

          // Validate password strength
          passwordInput.addEventListener("input", () => {
            const { strength, feedback } = validatePassword(
              passwordInput.value
            );

            // Update strength meter
            strengthMeter.style.width = `${strength}%`;
            strengthMeter.className = "strength-meter-bar";

            if (strength < 20) {
              strengthMeter.classList.add("very-weak");
            } else if (strength < 40) {
              strengthMeter.classList.add("weak");
            } else if (strength < 60) {
              strengthMeter.classList.add("medium");
            } else if (strength < 80) {
              strengthMeter.classList.add("strong");
            } else {
              strengthMeter.classList.add("very-strong");
            }

            // Update feedback
            passwordFeedback.textContent = feedback;

            // Check if passwords match
            if (passwordConfirmInput.value) {
              const match = checkPasswordsMatch(
                passwordInput.value,
                passwordConfirmInput.value
              );
              passwordMatchFeedback.textContent = match
                ? ""
                : "Passwords do not match";
              passwordMatchFeedback.classList.toggle("error", !match);
            }
          });

          // Check if passwords match
          passwordConfirmInput.addEventListener("input", () => {
            const match = checkPasswordsMatch(
              passwordInput.value,
              passwordConfirmInput.value
            );
            passwordMatchFeedback.textContent = match
              ? ""
              : "Passwords do not match";
            passwordMatchFeedback.classList.toggle("error", !match);
          });
        });

        // Handle form submission
        resetPasswordForm.addEventListener("submit", async function (e) {
          e.preventDefault();

          const password = passwordInput.value;
          const passwordConfirm = passwordConfirmInput.value;

          if (password !== passwordConfirm) {
            alert("Passwords do not match");
            return;
          }

          try {
            const response = await fetch(
              `/api/v1/users/resetPassword/${token}`,
              {
                method: "PATCH",
                headers: {
                  "Content-Type": "application/json",
                },
                body: JSON.stringify({ password, passwordConfirm }),
              }
            );

            const data = await response.json();

            if (response.ok) {
              // Show success message
              alert("Password reset successful!");

              // Redirect to login page
              window.location.href = "/login";
            } else {
              // Show error message
              alert(`Error: ${data.message || "Failed to reset password"}`);
            }
          } catch (err) {
            console.error("Error resetting password:", err);
            alert("An error occurred while resetting your password");
          }
        });
      });
    </script>
  </body>
</html>

```

```html
    <script type="module" src="/js/index.js" defer></script>
    <script type="module" src="/js/scheduleCalculator.js" defer></script>
    <title>RallyPoint - Schedule Calculator</title>
  </head>
  <body>
    <header>
      <h1>RallyPoint</h1>
    </header>

    <nav>
      <a href="/" aria-label="Home">
        <i class="fas fa-home"></i>
      </a>
      <a href="/events/myBrowse" aria-label="My Events">
        <i class="fas fa-calendar-check"></i>
      </a>
      <a href="/events/browseNew" aria-label="Find Events">
        <i class="fas fa-search"></i>
      </a>
      <a href="/me/myAccountDetails" aria-label="Profile">
        <i class="fas fa-user"></i>
      </a>
      <a href="/users/showAll" aria-label="Users" class="admin-only">
        <i class="fas fa-users"></i>
      </a>
      <a href="#" id="logoutButton" aria-label="Logout">
        <i class="fas fa-sign-out-alt"></i>
      </a>
    </nav>

    <main class="main">
      <section class="section">
        <div class="container">
          <div class="card">
            <div class="card-header">
              <h2 class="card-title">Schedule Calculator</h2>
              <p class="card-subtitle">
                Generate optimal schedules based on event parameters
              </p>
            </div>

            <div class="card-body">
              <form id="scheduleCalculatorForm" class="form">
                <div class="form-row">
                  <div class="form-group col-md-6">
                    <label for="numCourts">Number of Courts</label>
                    <input
                      type="number"
                      id="numCourts"
                      name="numCourts"
                      class="form-control"
                      min="1"
                      value="4"
                      required
                    />
                  </div>

                  <div class="form-group col-md-6">
                    <label for="numPlayers">Number of Players</label>
                    <input
                      type="number"
                      id="numPlayers"
                      name="numPlayers"
                      class="form-control"
                      min="4"
                      value="16"
                      required
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div class="form-row">
                  <div class="form-group col-md-6">
                    <label for="playersPerCourt">Players Per Court</label>
                    <input
                      type="number"
                      id="playersPerCourt"
                      name="playersPerCourt"
                      class="form-control"
                      min="2"
                      max="4"
                      value="4"
                      required
                    />
                  </div>

                  <div class="form-group col-md-6">
                    <label for="numRounds">Number of Rounds</label>
                    <input
                      type="number"
                      id="numRounds"
                      name="numRounds"
                      class="form-control"
                      min="1"
                      value="5"
                      required
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div class="form-row">
                  <div class="form-group col-md-6">
                    <label for="sessionLength">Session Length (minutes)</label>
                    <input
                      type="number"
                      id="sessionLength"
                      name="sessionLength"
                      class="form-control"
                      min="5"
                      value="15"
                      required
                    />
                  </div>

                  <div class="form-group col-md-6">
                    <label for="scheduleType">Schedule Type</label>
                    <select
                      id="scheduleType"
                      name="scheduleType"
                      class="form-control"
                    >
                      <option value="balanced">
                        Balanced (Even distribution)
                      </option>
                      <option value="competitive">
                        Competitive (Skill-based)
                      </option>
                      <option value="social">Social (Mix all players)</option>
                    </select>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div class="form-group">
                  <div class="checkbox-group">
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      id="allowPlayerRests"
                      name="allowPlayerRests"
                      class="checkbox-input"
                      checked
                    />
                    <label for="allowPlayerRests" class="checkbox-label"
                      >Allow player rest periods</label
                    >
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div class="form-actions">
                  <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary">
                    Generate Schedule
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    id="resetFormButton"
                    class="btn btn-outline"
                  >
                    Reset
                  </button>
                </div>
              </form>

              <div
                id="scheduleSummary"
                class="schedule-summary mt-4"
                style="display: none"
              >
                <h3>Schedule Summary</h3>
                <div class="summary-stats">
                  <div class="stat-item">
                    <span class="stat-label">Total Playing Time:</span>
                    <span id="totalPlayingTime" class="stat-value"
                      >0 minutes</span
                    >
                  </div>
                  <div class="stat-item">
                    <span class="stat-label">Average Games Per Player:</span>
                    <span id="avgGamesPerPlayer" class="stat-value">0</span>
                  </div>
                  <div class="stat-item">
                    <span class="stat-label">Total Sessions:</span>
                    <span id="totalSessions" class="stat-value">0</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div
                id="scheduleContainer"
                class="schedule-container mt-4"
                style="display: none"
              >
                <h3>Generated Schedule</h3>
                <div class="tabs">
                  <div class="tab-header">
                    <button class="tab-button active" data-tab="roundView">
                      Round View
                    </button>
                    <button class="tab-button" data-tab="playerView">
                      Player View
                    </button>
                    <button class="tab-button" data-tab="courtView">
                      Court View
                    </button>
                  </div>

                  <div class="tab-content">
                    <div id="roundView" class="tab-pane active">
                      <div id="roundSchedule" class="round-schedule"></div>
                    </div>

                    <div id="playerView" class="tab-pane">
                      <div id="playerSchedule" class="player-schedule"></div>
                    </div>

                    <div id="courtView" class="tab-pane">
                      <div id="courtSchedule" class="court-schedule"></div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div class="schedule-actions mt-4">
                  <button id="saveScheduleButton" class="btn btn-primary">
                    <i class="fas fa-save"></i> Save Schedule
                  </button>
                  <button id="printScheduleButton" class="btn btn-outline">
                    <i class="fas fa-print"></i> Print Schedule
                  </button>
                  <button id="exportScheduleButton" class="btn btn-outline">
                    <i class="fas fa-file-export"></i> Export as CSV
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>
    </main>

    <script>
      document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
        const scheduleCalculatorForm = document.getElementById(
          "scheduleCalculatorForm"
        );
        const resetFormButton = document.getElementById("resetFormButton");
        const scheduleSummary = document.getElementById("scheduleSummary");
        const scheduleContainer = document.getElementById("scheduleContainer");
        const tabButtons = document.querySelectorAll(".tab-button");
        const tabPanes = document.querySelectorAll(".tab-pane");

        // Tab functionality
        tabButtons.forEach((button) => {
          button.addEventListener("click", function () {
            // Remove active class from all buttons and panes
            tabButtons.forEach((btn) => btn.classList.remove("active"));
            tabPanes.forEach((pane) => pane.classList.remove("active"));

            // Add active class to clicked button and corresponding pane
            this.classList.add("active");
            const tabId = this.getAttribute("data-tab");
            document.getElementById(tabId).classList.add("active");
          });
        });

        // Reset form
        resetFormButton.addEventListener("click", function () {
          scheduleCalculatorForm.reset();
          scheduleSummary.style.display = "none";
          scheduleContainer.style.display = "none";
        });

        // Handle form submission
        scheduleCalculatorForm.addEventListener("submit", function (e) {
          e.preventDefault();

          // Get form values
          const numCourts = parseInt(
            document.getElementById("numCourts").value
          );
          const numPlayers = parseInt(
            document.getElementById("numPlayers").value
          );
          const playersPerCourt = parseInt(
            document.getElementById("playersPerCourt").value
          );
          const numRounds = parseInt(
            document.getElementById("numRounds").value
          );
          const sessionLength = parseInt(
            document.getElementById("sessionLength").value
          );
          const scheduleType = document.getElementById("scheduleType").value;
          const allowPlayerRests =
            document.getElementById("allowPlayerRests").checked;

          // Basic validation
          if (numPlayers < playersPerCourt) {
            alert(
              "Number of players must be at least equal to players per court"
            );
            return;
          }

          // Call the schedule calculator module
          import("/js/scheduleCalculator.js").then((module) => {
            const { generateSchedule, displaySchedule } = module;

            // Generate the schedule
            const schedule = generateSchedule({
              numCourts,
              numPlayers,
              playersPerCourt,
              numRounds,
              sessionLength,
              scheduleType,
              allowPlayerRests,
            });

            if (schedule) {
              // Update summary statistics
              document.getElementById("totalPlayingTime").textContent =
                `${schedule.totalPlayingTime} minutes`;
              document.getElementById("avgGamesPerPlayer").textContent =
                schedule.avgGamesPerPlayer.toFixed(1);
              document.getElementById("totalSessions").textContent =
                schedule.totalSessions;

              // Display the schedule
              displaySchedule(schedule, {
                roundElement: document.getElementById("roundSchedule"),
                playerElement: document.getElementById("playerSchedule"),
                courtElement: document.getElementById("courtSchedule"),
              });

              // Show the schedule sections
              scheduleSummary.style.display = "block";
              scheduleContainer.style.display = "block";

              // Add event listeners for the schedule action buttons
              document
                .getElementById("saveScheduleButton")
                .addEventListener("click", function () {
                  // Implementation for saving the schedule will go here
                  alert("Schedule saved successfully!");
                });

              document
                .getElementById("printScheduleButton")
                .addEventListener("click", function () {
                  window.print();
                });

              document
                .getElementById("exportScheduleButton")
                .addEventListener("click", function () {
                  // Implementation for exporting as CSV will go here
                  const csv = convertScheduleToCSV(schedule);
                  downloadCSV(csv, "schedule.csv");
                });
            } else {
              alert(
                "Failed to generate schedule. Please check your parameters and try again."
              );
            }
          });
        });

        // Helper function to convert schedule to CSV
        function convertScheduleToCSV(schedule) {
          // Implementation will go here
          let csv = "Round,Court,Players\n";

          schedule.rounds.forEach((round, roundIndex) => {
            round.courts.forEach((court, courtIndex) => {
              const players = court.players.join(", ");
              csv += `${roundIndex + 1},${courtIndex + 1},"${players}"\n`;
            });
          });

          return csv;
        }

        // Helper function to download CSV
        function downloadCSV(csv, filename) {
          const blob = new Blob([csv], { type: "text/csv;charset=utf-8;" });
          const link = document.createElement("a");

          if (navigator.msSaveBlob) {
            // IE 10+
            navigator.msSaveBlob(blob, filename);
          } else {
            const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
            link.href = url;
            link.download = filename;
            document.body.appendChild(link);
            link.click();
            document.body.removeChild(link);
          }
        }
      });
    </script>
  </body>
</html>
```

```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <meta http-equiv="X-UA-Compatible" content="IE=edge" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
    <meta name="description" content="Pickleball admin - All Schedules" />
    <link rel="icon" href="/img/favicon.png" />
    <link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="/img/apple-touch-icon.png" />
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" />
    <link
      href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Rubik:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap"
      rel="stylesheet"
    />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="/css/styles.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="/css/mediaQueries.css" />
    <script
      type="module"
      src="https://unpkg.com/ionicons@5.4.0/dist/ionicons/ionicons.esm.js"
    ></script>
    <script
      nomodule=""
      src="https://unpkg.com/ionicons@5.4.0/dist/ionicons/ionicons.js"
    ></script>
    <title>Pickleball | All Schedules</title>
  </head>
  <body>
    <!-- Header will be included dynamically -->
    <div id="header-placeholder"></div>

    <main>
      <section class="section-list">
        <div class="container">
          <form method="get" action="" class="filter-form">
            <label for="organiser">Filter by organiser:</label>
            <input
              id="organiser"
              type="text"
              name="organiser"
              placeholder="Enter organiser"
            />
            <label for="date">Filter by date:</label>
            <input id="date" type="date" name="date" />
            <button type="submit">Filter</button>
          </form>

          <div class="schedule-table">
            <p class="subheading">Event Name</p>
            <p class="subheading">Organiser</p>
            <p class="subheading">Date</p>
            <p class="subheading">Time</p>
            <!-- Events will be populated by JavaScript -->
            <div id="events-container"></div>
          </div>

          <!-- Pagination controls -->
          <div id="pagination-controls" class="pagination"></div>
        </div>
      </section>
    </main>

    <!-- Template data script -->
    <script>
      // This will be populated by server with actual data
      window.templateData = window.templateData || {};
    </script>

    <!-- Load header component -->
    <script>
      // This script dynamically loads the header
      fetch("/includes/header.html")
        .then((response) => response.text())
        .then((data) => {
          document.getElementById("header-placeholder").innerHTML = data;
        })
        .catch((error) => console.error("Error loading header:", error));
    </script>

    <!-- Main page script -->
    <script>
      document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
        // Access template data from server
        const { events, filters, pagination } = window.templateData;

        // Set filter values if they exist
        if (filters) {
          document.getElementById("organiser").value = filters.organiser || "";
          document.getElementById("date").value = filters.date || "";
        }

        // Generate event rows
        const eventsContainer = document.getElementById("events-container");
        if (events && events.length) {
          events.forEach((event) => {
            // Format date
            const eventDate = new Date(event.eventDate);
            const options = {
              weekday: "short",
              year: "numeric",
              month: "short",
              day: "numeric",
            };
            const formattedDate = eventDate.toLocaleDateString(
              "en-GB",
              options
            );

            // Create row elements
            const row = document.createElement("div");
            row.className = "table-row";

            // Event name with link
            const nameCell = document.createElement("p");
            nameCell.className = "listItemText";
            const nameLink = document.createElement("a");
            nameLink.href = `/events/viewMasterSchedule/${event._id}`;
            nameLink.textContent = event.eventName;
            nameCell.appendChild(nameLink);

            // Organiser
            const organiserCell = document.createElement("p");
            organiserCell.className = "listItemText";
            organiserCell.textContent = event.eventOrganiser;

            // Date
            const dateCell = document.createElement("p");
            dateCell.className = "listItemText";
            dateCell.textContent = formattedDate;

            // Time
            const timeCell = document.createElement("p");
            timeCell.className = "listItemText";
            timeCell.textContent = event.eventStartTime;

            // Append all cells to row
            row.appendChild(nameCell);
            row.appendChild(organiserCell);
            row.appendChild(dateCell);
            row.appendChild(timeCell);

            // Add row to container
            eventsContainer.appendChild(row);
          });
        } else {
          // No events found
          eventsContainer.innerHTML =
            '<div class="table-row"><p class="listItemText">No schedules found</p></div>';
        }

        // Generate pagination if needed
        if (pagination) {
          const paginationControls = document.getElementById(
            "pagination-controls"
          );

          // Create pagination UI
          if (pagination.totalPages > 1) {
            // Previous page button
            if (pagination.currentPage > 1) {
              const prevLink = createPaginationLink(
                pagination.currentPage - 1,
                "&laquo; Previous"
              );
              paginationControls.appendChild(prevLink);
            }

            // Page numbers
            for (let i = 1; i <= pagination.totalPages; i++) {
              const pageLink = createPaginationLink(i, i.toString());
              if (i === pagination.currentPage) {
                pageLink.classList.add("active");
              }
              paginationControls.appendChild(pageLink);
            }

            // Next page button
            if (pagination.currentPage < pagination.totalPages) {
              const nextLink = createPaginationLink(
                pagination.currentPage + 1,
                "Next &raquo;"
              );
              paginationControls.appendChild(nextLink);
            }
          }
        }

        // Helper function to create pagination links
        function createPaginationLink(page, text) {
          const link = document.createElement("a");
          link.href = `?page=${page}`;
          link.innerHTML = text;

          // Add current filters to pagination links
          if (filters) {
            if (filters.organiser) {
              link.href += `&organiser=${encodeURIComponent(filters.organiser)}`;
            }
            if (filters.date) {
              link.href += `&date=${encodeURIComponent(filters.date)}`;
            }
          }

          return link;
        }
      });
    </script>
  </body>
</html>
```

```html
    <script type="module">
      document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
        // Data would be injected by server when rendering the page
        const event = window.eventData || { eventName: "Event", eventDate: new Date(), eventStartTime: "12:00", eventLocation: "Location" };
        const filteredMatches = window.matchesData || [];
        const restingRounds = window.restingRounds || [];
        const showScoreButton = window.features?.teamCanEditScore || false;
        
        // Format the event title
        const options = {weekday: "short", year: "numeric", month: "short", day: "numeric"};
        const eventDate = new Date(event.eventDate).toLocaleDateString(undefined, options);
        const eventTitle = `${event.eventName} on ${eventDate} @ ${event.eventStartTime} in ${event.eventLocation}`;
        document.getElementById('event-title').textContent = eventTitle;
        
        // Show resting rounds info
        const restingInfo = document.getElementById('resting-info');
        if (restingRounds && restingRounds.length) {
          restingInfo.innerHTML = `You will be resting in round(s): ${restingRounds.map(r => ' ' + (r + 1)).join(',')}`;
        } else {
          restingInfo.innerHTML = 'You are playing in every round.';
        }
        
        // Build the schedule table
        const scheduleTable = document.querySelector('.schedule-table');
        if (filteredMatches && filteredMatches.length) {
          const tableHTML = `
            <div class="schedule-grid ${showScoreButton ? 'with-score-button' : ''}">
              ${filteredMatches.map(matchData => `
                <div class="schedule-row">
                  <div class="schedule-cell">
                    <span class="label">Round:</span>
                    <span class="value">${matchData.round + 1}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div class="schedule-cell">
                    <span class="label">Court:</span>
                    <span class="value">${matchData.match.court + 1}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div class="schedule-cell">
                    <span class="label">My Team:</span>
                    <span class="value">${matchData.match[matchData.playerTeam].map(p => p.name).join(' & ')}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div class="schedule-cell">
                    <span class="label">Opposing Team:</span>
                    <span class="value">
                      ${matchData.match[matchData.playerTeam === 'teamA' ? 'teamB' : 'teamA'].map(p => p.name).join(' & ')}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div class="schedule-cell">
                    <span class="label">Score:</span>
                    <span class="value">${typeof matchData.match.teamAScore === "number" ? matchData.match.teamAScore : 0} / ${typeof matchData.match.teamBScore === "number" ? matchData.match.teamBScore : 0}</span>
                  </div>
                  ${showScoreButton ? `
                    <div class="schedule-cell">
                      <button class="btn btn--secondary btn-score" 
                        data-round="${matchData.round}"
                        data-matchindex="${matchData.matchIndex}"
                        data-eventid="${event._id}"
                        data-teama-score="${matchData.match.teamAScore || 0}"
                        data-teamb-score="${matchData.match.teamBScore || 0}">
                        ${matchData.hasScore ? 'Edit Score' : 'Enter Score'}
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  ` : ''}
                </div>
              `).join('')}
            </div>
          `;
          scheduleTable.innerHTML = tableHTML;
        } else {
          scheduleTable.innerHTML = '<p class="text-center">No matches found in your schedule.</p>';
        }
        
        // Score modal functionality
        if (showScoreButton) {
          const modal = document.getElementById('scoreModal');
          const closeModal = document.querySelector('.modal__close');
          const cancelModal = document.querySelector('.modal__cancel');
          const scoreForm = document.getElementById('scoreForm');
          
          // Open modal when clicking score buttons
          document.querySelectorAll('.btn-score').forEach(btn => {
            btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
              document.getElementById('scoreRound').value = btn.dataset.round;
              document.getElementById('scoreMatch').value = btn.dataset.matchindex;
              document.getElementById('scoreEvent').value = btn.dataset.eventid;
              document.getElementById('teamAScore').value = btn.dataset.teamaScore;
              document.getElementById('teamBScore').value = btn.dataset.teambScore;
              modal.classList.remove('hidden');
            });
          });
          
          // Close modal functions
          closeModal.addEventListener('click', () => modal.classList.add('hidden'));
          cancelModal.addEventListener('click', () => modal.classList.add('hidden'));
          
          // Submit form
          scoreForm.addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            try {
              // This would be handled by eventUpdateMatchScoreApiAction through initFormListeners
              // Just closing the modal here as the actual API call is handled elsewhere
              modal.classList.add('hidden');
            } catch (error) {
              console.error('Error updating score:', error);
            }
          });
        }
      });
    </script>
  </body>
</html>
```

```html
<script>
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
    // Get user role from window.templateData
    const templateData = window.templateData || {};
    const userRole = templateData.userRole;
    const userName = templateData.userName;
    const showNav = templateData.showNav !== false;

    // Only show navigation if showNav is true
    if (showNav) {
      // Insert appropriate navigation based on user role
      if (userRole === "clubAdmin") {
        fetch("/includes/navLoggedInAsAdmin.html")
          .then((response) => response.text())
          .then((html) => {
            const navContainer = document.getElementById(
              "navigation-container"
            );
            navContainer.innerHTML = html.replace(
              "{{userName}}",
              userName || "User"
            );

            // Initialize navigation behaviors after loading
            initializeNavigation();
          });
      } else if (userRole === "user") {
        fetch("/includes/navLoggedInAsUser.html")
          .then((response) => response.text())
          .then((html) => {
            const navContainer = document.getElementById(
              "navigation-container"
            );
            navContainer.innerHTML = html.replace(
              "{{userName}}",
              userName || "User"
            );

            // Initialize navigation behaviors after loading
            initializeNavigation();
          });
      }
    }
  });

  function initializeNavigation() {
    // Toggle settings dropdown
    const settingsToggle = document.querySelector(".settings-toggle");
    if (settingsToggle) {
      settingsToggle.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        const dropdown = document.querySelector(".settings-dropdown");
        dropdown.classList.toggle("show");
      });
    }

    // Mobile navigation toggle
    const mobileNavToggle = document.getElementById("mobileNavToggle");
    if (mobileNavToggle) {
      mobileNavToggle.addEventListener("click", function () {
        document.body.classList.toggle("nav-open");
      });
    }

    // Logout functionality
    const logoutButtons = document.querySelectorAll(".logOutButton");
    logoutButtons.forEach((button) => {
      button.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        // Call the logout API endpoint
        fetch("/api/v1/users/logout", {
          method: "GET",
          credentials: "same-origin",
        })
          .then((res) => {
            if (res.status === 200) {
              // Redirect to login page
              window.location.href = "/me/login";
            }
          })
          .catch((err) => {
            console.error("Logout failed:", err);
          });
      });
    });
  }
</script>
```

## public/includes/pagination.html

*Size: 2817 bytes*

```html
<!-- Pagination component -->
<div class="pagination">
  <script>
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
      const templateData = window.templateData || {};
      const pagination = templateData.pagination || {};

      if (pagination.totalPages > 1) {
        const paginationContainer = document.querySelector(".pagination");
        const paginationList = document.createElement("ul");
        paginationList.className = "pagination-list";

        // Previous button
        if (pagination.currentPage > 1) {
          const prevItem = document.createElement("li");
          const prevLink = document.createElement("a");
          prevLink.href = `?page=${pagination.currentPage - 1}`;
          prevLink.textContent = "Previous";

          // Add any existing query parameters
          if (window.location.search) {
            const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
            urlParams.delete("page");
            if (urlParams.toString()) {
              prevLink.href += `&${urlParams.toString()}`;
            }
          }

          prevItem.appendChild(prevLink);
          paginationList.appendChild(prevItem);
        }

        // Page numbers
        for (let i = 1; i <= pagination.totalPages; i++) {
          const pageItem = document.createElement("li");
          if (i === pagination.currentPage) {
            pageItem.className = "active";
          }

          const pageLink = document.createElement("a");
          pageLink.href = `?page=${i}`;
          pageLink.textContent = i;

          // Add any existing query parameters
          if (window.location.search) {
            const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
            urlParams.delete("page");
            if (urlParams.toString()) {
              pageLink.href += `&${urlParams.toString()}`;
            }
          }

          pageItem.appendChild(pageLink);
          paginationList.appendChild(pageItem);
        }

        // Next button
        if (pagination.currentPage < pagination.totalPages) {
          const nextItem = document.createElement("li");
          const nextLink = document.createElement("a");
          nextLink.href = `?page=${pagination.currentPage + 1}`;
          nextLink.textContent = "Next";

          // Add any existing query parameters
          if (window.location.search) {
            const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
            urlParams.delete("page");
            if (urlParams.toString()) {
              nextLink.href += `&${urlParams.toString()}`;
            }
          }

          nextItem.appendChild(nextLink);
          paginationList.appendChild(nextItem);
        }

        paginationContainer.appendChild(paginationList);
      }
    });
  </script>
</div>

```

```js
// accountDetails.js - Handles account details page functionality
import { showAlert } from "./alerts.js";

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  const acDetailsForm = document.getElementById("acDetailsForm");

  // Form submission handler
  if (acDetailsForm) {
    acDetailsForm.addEventListener("submit", async (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();

      const userId = document.getElementById("userId").value;
      const name = document.getElementById("name").value;
      const email = document.getElementById("email").value;
      const mobile = document.getElementById("mobile").value;

      // Form validation
      if (!name || !email || !mobile) {
        showAlert("error", "Please fill in all required fields");
        return;
      }

      try {
        const response = await fetch(`/api/users/updateMyDetails/${userId}`, {
          method: "PATCH",
          headers: {
            "Content-Type": "application/json",
          },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            name,
            email,
            mobile,
            userId,
          }),
        });

        const data = await response.json();

        if (response.ok) {
          showAlert("success", "Account details updated successfully");
          setTimeout(() => {
            window.location.href = "/events/browseNew";
          }, 1500);
        } else {
          showAlert(
            "error",
            data.message || "Failed to update account details"
          );
        }
      } catch (err) {
        showAlert("error", "Something went wrong. Please try again.");
      }
    });
  }
});
```

```js
// type is 'success' or 'error'

export const hideAlert = () => {
  const el = document.querySelector('.alert');
  if (el) el.parentElement.removeChild(el);
};

export const showAlert = (type, msg) => {
  hideAlert();
  const markup = `<div class="alert alert--${type}">${msg}</div>`;
  document.querySelector('body').insertAdjacentHTML('afterbegin', markup);
  window.setTimeout(hideAlert, 5000);
};

```

```js
// api.js
// The CDN version of axios doesn't use ES module exports
// So we need to use it as a global variable
// No need to import it as it will be loaded via script tag

// Create a wrapper module around axios
const api = {
  request: function (options) {
    // Make sure axios is available
    if (typeof axios === "undefined") {
      console.error("Axios is not loaded! Check script loading in HTML.");
      throw new Error("Axios is not available");
    }

    return axios(options);
  },
};

// Configure axios defaults if available
if (typeof axios !== "undefined") {
  axios.defaults.withCredentials = true;
}

// Export our API wrapper
export default api;

```

```js
/* eslint-disable */
// Use modern browser APIs directly instead of polyfills
import axios from "./api.js";
import { showAlert } from "./alerts.js";

// --- Helper Functions ---
// Export this function so it can be used by other modules
export async function apiRequest({
  method,
  url,
  data,
  onSuccess,
  successMessage,
  redirect,
  reload,
}) {
  try {
    console.log(`[API Request] ${method} ${url}`);
    const res = await axios.request({ method, url, data });
    console.log(`[API Response] ${method} ${url}:`, res);

    if (res.data?.status === "success" || res.status === 204) {
      if (successMessage) showAlert("success", successMessage);
      if (onSuccess) onSuccess(res);

      // Store user data in localStorage if we're logging in and have user data
      if (redirect === "userLoggingIn" && res.data.user) {
        // Store user data for role detection
        localStorage.setItem("userData", JSON.stringify(res.data.user));

        let landingPage;
        if (res.data.user.role === "clubAdmin") {
          landingPage = "/events/showAll";
        } else {
          landingPage = "/events/myBrowse";
        }
        window.setTimeout(() => location.assign(landingPage), 1500);
      } else if (redirect) {
        window.setTimeout(() => location.assign(redirect), 1500);
      } else if (reload) {
        window.setTimeout(() => location.reload(), 1500);
      }
    }
    return res;
  } catch (err) {
    handleError(err);
    throw err;
  }
}

// Global variable to track the last error message time
let lastErrorTime = 0;

function handleError(err) {
  // Log detailed error information
  console.error("[API Error]", err);
  if (err.response) {
    console.error("Error Response:", {
      status: err.response.status,
      statusText: err.response.statusText,
      data: err.response.data,
    });
  }

  // Only show one error every 3 seconds
  const now = Date.now();
  if (now - lastErrorTime < 3000) {
    console.log("Suppressing duplicate error message");
    return;
  }

  // Update the last error time
  lastErrorTime = now;

  // Remove any existing alerts
  const existingAlerts = document.querySelectorAll(".alert");
  if (existingAlerts.length > 0) {
    existingAlerts.forEach((alert) => {
      alert.parentElement.removeChild(alert);
    });
  }

  if (err.response && err.response.data && err.response.data.message) {
    showAlert("error", err.response.data.message);
  } else {
    showAlert("error", err.message || "An unexpected error occurred");
  }
}

// --- User Actions ---
export const createUserApiAction = async (
  name,
  email,
  mobile,
  password,
  passwordConfirm,
  active
) =>
  apiRequest({
    method: "POST",
    url: "/api/v1/users",
    data: { name, email, mobile, password, passwordConfirm, active },
    successMessage: "User successfully created",
    redirect: "/users/showall",
  });

export const editUserApiAction = async (userId, name, email, mobile, active) =>
  apiRequest({
    method: "PATCH",
    url: `/api/v1/users/${userId}`,
    data: { name, email, mobile, active },
    successMessage: "User successfully updated",
    redirect: "/users/showall",
  });

export const deleteUserApiAction = async (userId) =>
  apiRequest({
    method: "DELETE",
    url: `/api/v1/users/${userId}`,
    successMessage: "User successfully deleted",
    redirect: "/users/showall",
  });

// --- Event Actions ---
export const createEventApiAction = async (data) =>
  apiRequest({
    method: "POST",
    url: "/api/v1/events",
    data,
    successMessage: "Event successfully created",
    redirect: "/events/showAll",
  });

export const updateEventApiAction = async (data) =>
  apiRequest({
    method: "PATCH",
    url: `/api/v1/events/${data.eventId}`,
    data,
    successMessage: "Event successfully updated",
    redirect: "/events/showAll",
  });

export const deleteEventApiAction = async (eventId) =>
  apiRequest({
    method: "DELETE",
    url: `/api/events/${eventId}`,
    successMessage: "Event successfully deleted",
    redirect: "/events/showAll",
  });

export const eventCreateBookingApiAction = async (eventId) => {
  try {
    const response = await axios({
      method: "POST",
      url: `/api/v1/events/book`,
      data: { eventId },
    });

    if (response.data?.status === "success") {
      showAlert("success", "Booking successful");
      setTimeout(() => {
        window.location.reload();
      }, 1500);
      return response.data;
    }
    return null;
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("Booking error:", err);
    if (err.response?.status === 404) {
      showAlert("error", "Booking endpoint not found. Please contact support.");
    } else {
      handleError(err);
    }
    throw err;
  }
};

export const eventCancelBookingApiAction = async (eventId) =>
  apiRequest({
    method: "PATCH",
    url: `/api/v1/events/booking/cancel`,
    successMessage: "Booking cancelled",
    data: { eventId },
    reload: true,
  });

export const eventUpdateMatchScoreApiAction = async (
  roundIndex,
  matchIndex,
  teamAScore,
  teamBScore,
  eventId
) =>
  apiRequest({
    method: "PATCH",
    url: `/api/v1/events/updateMatchscore`,
    data: { roundIndex, matchIndex, teamAScore, teamBScore, eventId },
    successMessage: "Score updated",
    reload: true,
  });

export const markNoShowApiAction = async (eventId, userId) =>
  apiRequest({
    method: "POST",
    url: "/api/v1/events/noShow",
    data: { eventId, userId },
    successMessage: "No show processed and schedule recalculated",
    reload: true,
  });

// --- Auth Actions ---
export const loginApiAction = async (email, password) =>
  apiRequest({
    method: "POST",
    url: "/api/v1/users/login",
    data: { email, password },
    successMessage: "Logged in successfully!",
    redirect: "userLoggingIn",
```
